item.title: GB Cinq suspects d'un projet d'attentat contre une base de la RAF libérés sous caution
item.description: La police britannique a interrogé lundi cinq hommes suspectés de projet terroriste avant d'annoncer leur libération sous caution, au lendemain de leur interpellation près d'une base aérienne utilisée par les États-Unis pour mener des frappes contre l'Iran.
item.dc:creator: Toby Shepheard
item.content:encoded: La police britannique a interrogé lundi cinq hommes suspectés de projet terroriste avant d'annoncer leur libération sous caution, au lendemain de leur interpellation près d'une base aérienne utilisée par les États-Unis pour mener des frappes contre l'Iran. Le chef des services antiterroristes, Laurence Taylor, a déclaré lors d'une conférence de presse que les suspects faisaient toujours l'objet d'une enquête et que plusieurs pistes restaient à l'étude, y compris la possibilité qu'un ou plusieurs individus agissant pour le compte d'un État étranger aient été impliqués dans le projet présumé. La police a arrêté les cinq hommes tôt dimanche matin après avoir été alertée par une agricultrice que trois grandes camionnettes blanches se dirigeaient vers la base aérienne de la Royal Air Force (RAF) de Fairford, dans l'ouest de l'Angleterre, qui abrite des bombardiers américains effectuant des missions contre l'Iran. "Pour être très clair, (la libération sous caution des suspects) ne signifie pas que l'enquête est terminée", a déclaré Laurence Taylor devant le siège de la police londonienne, précisant que les hommes seraient relâchés lundi. "Ils restent pleinement visés par l'enquête tandis que nous explorons plusieurs pistes", a-t-il également indiqué, ajoutant que les cinq individus, suspectés d'infractions à la législation relative aux explosifs et de projet d'acte terroriste, seraient soumis à un strict contrôle judiciaire. Les autorités avaient auparavant fait savoir que les suspects étaient tous des ressortissants britanniques originaires de Londres et âgés d'une vingtaine d'années. Avant l'annonce de leur libération sous caution, une source proche de l'enquête a déclaré à Reuters qu'un mobile lié à l'Iran était considéré comme le plus probable, même si la piste d'une opération de sabotage russe ou d'un complot islamiste est également examinée. DES HOMMES "CAGOULÉS ET MASQUÉS" COURANT À TRAVERS CHAMPS L'ambassade d'Iran, dans un communiqué publié sur le réseau X, a évoqué des "spéculations infondées et malveillantes", ajoutant qu'elle "rejetait catégoriquement et condamnait fermement" toute tentative de relier Téhéran aux arrestations et que de telles spéculations ne feraient qu'"alimenter la propagande iranophobe" au Royaume-Uni. Laurence Tayor, sans explicitement mentionner l'Iran, a dit avoir conscience du vif intérêt que suscite un éventuel lien entre le contexte géopolitique actuel et cet incident. "Soyez assurés que nous examinons cette affaire sous tous les angles possibles, y compris l'hypothèse qu'elle ait été activement menée par des intermédiaires ou par des individus travaillant, sciemment ou non, pour le compte d'un État étranger." Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré dimanche que les suspects avaient tenté de causer "d'importants dégâts" et qu'ils avaient fait l'objet d'une surveillance de la part des autorités britanniques et américaines, affirmation qui a questionné certains médias britanniques compte tenu de la proximité des hommes avec la base au moment de leur arrestation. La source proche de l'enquête a précisé que celle-ci n'était pas le résultat d'un renseignement préalable, bien que les mesures de sécurité aient été renforcées autour de la base. L'agricultrice ayant alerté la police, dont l'identité n'a pas été révélée, a indiqué à la BBC avoir vu un groupe d'"hommes cagoulés et masqués" courir à travers champs, estimant que son appel au numéro d'urgence 999 avait à lui seul "fait échouer leurs plans". RÉUNION DU COMITÉ DE CRISE GOUVERNEMENTAL Le ministre de la Défense, Wes Streeting, a déclaré à la BBC que l'agricultrice n'avait qu'une "vision partielle" de la situation, ajoutant qu'il ne spéculerait pas sur les motifs d'une enquête en cours. Evoquant la menace iranienne qui pèse globalement sur le pays, il a toutefois déclaré : "Nous savons que l'Iran et ses relais veulent nous nuire. Nous savons qu'ils haïssent notre démocratie, et nous savons que nous devons régulièrement déjouer les tentatives iraniennes visant à menacer soit nos intérêts, soit nos alliés." Le Premier ministre Andy Burnham a annoncé qu'il présiderait plus tard lundi une réunion du comité gouvernemental chargé de la gestion des situations d'urgence (Cobra). Le gouvernement britannique a autorisé les États-Unis à utiliser des bombardiers basés à Fairford pour frapper des sites de missiles iraniens qui attaquaient des navires dans le détroit d'Ormuz. Les Gardiens de la révolution iraniens avaient averti Londres en juillet de ne pas le faire, ajoutant que toute base utilisée pour lancer des attaques deviendrait une cible légitime. L'AMBASSADE US ÉMET UNE ALERTE DE SÉCURITÉ La Grande-Bretagne a relevé en avril son niveau national de menace terroriste de "substantiel" à "grave", après une série d'incidents antisémites dans le nord de Londres, indiquant qu'une attaque terroriste dans les six prochains mois était considérée comme hautement probable. La police a dit enquêter sur des connexions avec l'Iran dans de nombreux incidents au cours desquels des biens liés à la communauté juive ou à des dissidents iraniens ont été pris pour cible. En réaction aux arrestations de Fairford, l'ambassade des États-Unis a publié une alerte de sécurité recommandant aux citoyens américains de "faire preuve de prudence" et d'être "attentifs à leur sécurité personnelle". "Les installations, rassemblements et organisations liés aux États-Unis pourraient être exposés à un risque accru", selon cette alerte. À Fairford, la police a établi un périmètre de sécurité de 400 mètres autour de la base et évacué les habitants de 85 logements du village voisin de Whelford, dont les autorités ont indiqué lundi qu'ils allaient bientôt pouvoir regagner leur domicile.

item.title: BCE-Une réponse mesurée reste appropriée pour juguler l'inflation, dit Lagarde
item.description: Une réponse mesurée reste appropriée pour contenir la hausse des prix, a déclaré lundi la présidente de la Banque centrale européenne, Christine Lagarde, l'inflation enregistrée cette année n'ayant pas encore entraîné d'effets de second tour dans la zone euro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Une réponse mesurée reste appropriée pour contenir la hausse des prix, a déclaré lundi la présidente de la Banque centrale européenne, Christine Lagarde, l'inflation enregistrée cette année n'ayant pas encore entraîné d'effets de second tour dans la zone euro. L'inflation en zone euro a déjà dépassé les 3% et pourrait avoisiner les 4% d’ici la fin de l’année, soit le double de l’objectif fixé par Francfort, ce qui alimente les paris des marchés selon lesquels jusqu’à quatre hausses de taux supplémentaires seront nécessaires l’année prochaine, en plus des deux déjà décidées en juin et début septembre. Christine Lagarde a fait valoir que la flambée des prix du pétrole et du gaz, liée au conflit entre les États-Unis et l’Iran, était le principal facteur à l’origine de la hausse des prix. "Nous anticipons une hausse de l’inflation, mais ne voyons pour l’instant aucun signe indiquant qu’elle s’installe durablement", a-t-elle déclaré lors d'une audition devant une commission du Parlement européen à Bruxelles. "À ce stade, nous ne disposons d’aucun élément indiquant que les prix de l’énergie se répercutent sur les salaires." "Cela signifie que, même si le choc est trop important pour être ignoré, nous estimons qu’une réponse mesurée est appropriée pour contenir l’inflation", a-t-elle ajouté. Christine Lagarde a toutefois reconnu que les risques penchaient en faveur d’une inflation plus élevée et que les perspectives étaient entachées d’une forte incertitude. Bien que la notion de "réponse mesurée" reste floue, les économistes estiment que les deux premières hausses de taux, espacées de trois mois, constituent un bon indicateur. Par conséquent, de nombreux économistes s’attendent à ce que la BCE s’abstienne d’agir lors de sa réunion du 29 octobre et ne procède à une hausse qu’en décembre, lors de la publication des nouvelles projections. Selon les données LSEG, les marchés anticipent à 57% la probabilité d'un maintien des taux par la BCE fin octobre. Christine Lagarde a souligné avec optimisme que le secteur manufacturier affichait de solides performances, que le marché du travail restait robuste et que l’investissement devrait également soutenir la croissance.

item.title: Shein registra un crecimiento de 1% en ingresos en sus primeros resultados tras salir a bolsa
item.description: La minorista de moda en línea enfrenta una desaceleración de la demanda, mayores costes y presión regulatoria, mientras sus acciones cotizan casi 27% por debajo del precio de salida a bolsa.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Shein Global Holdings Ltd. registró un crecimiento del 1% en sus ingresos netos durante el primer semestre de 2026, según sus primeros resultados como empresa que cotiza en bolsa, en un contexto en el que el minorista de moda en línea se enfrenta a una desaceleración de la demanda y al aumento de los costes. Shein, que debutó en la bolsa de Hong Kong el 1 de septiembre, indicó el lunes en un comunicado a la bolsa que el resultado de explotación cayó un 52,9% con respecto al primer semestre de 2025, lo que prolonga el deterioro de la rentabilidad observado en los tres primeros meses del año. Shein ya había advertido en su solicitud de salida a bolsa que la guerra en Irán afectaría a sus resultados del primer semestre. En aquel momento, pronosticó que el crecimiento de los ingresos se mantendría, en líneas generales, en la línea del 1,1% registrado en el primer trimestre, con un margen operativo ligeramente inferior. Ver más: Shein pierde US$5.000 millones de valor tras una de las peores salidas a bolsa de Hong Kong Los resultados se dan a conocer menos de un mes después de que el debut de Shein culminara un proceso de varios años, y repetidamente retrasado, hacia los mercados públicos. Su valoración, de unos US$26.000 millones, representaba una fracción de los aproximadamente US$100.000 millones que alcanzaba en su punto álgido de 2022. “Prevemos que el entorno externo siga siendo incierto en el segundo semestre de 2026, y es probable que persistan los obstáculos arancelarios y la volatilidad de los costes logísticos”, señaló la empresa en su informe provisional. “Dicho esto, el cuarto trimestre —que abarca el 11.11, el Black Friday, el Cyber Monday y la temporada navideña— sigue siendo nuestro periodo promocional más importante y debería impulsar un aumento significativo de los pedidos”. El crecimiento de los ingresos y la rentabilidad de Shein se han deteriorado desde el año pasado, lo que ha aumentado la presión sobre los directivos para que tranquilicen a los inversores, ya que la acción cotiza casi un 27% por debajo de su precio de salida a bolsa. La empresa se enfrenta a una ralentización de la demanda, al aumento de los costes y a una creciente presión regulatoria. Los primeros indicadores apuntan a un mayor debilitamiento en el tercer trimestre. Los datos de terceros, las entrevistas de Bloomberg con los principales proveedores y las estimaciones de los analistas sugieren que la situación se ha deteriorado aún más durante este periodo, caracterizado por unas ventas más débiles en Estados Unidos y un descenso del tráfico web a nivel mundial. Esto aumentará la presión sobre Shein para que expanda sus nuevas líneas de negocio con mayor rapidez, con el fin de compensar el deterioro de su actividad principal en el sector de la moda ultrarrápida. Ver más: El desafío de Shein tras debutar en bolsa: demostrar que puede volver a crecer con rentabilidad “Sin una estrategia clara para abordar las preocupaciones sobre el crecimiento a corto plazo, revertir su caída a largo plazo será todo un reto”, afirmó Shen Meng, director del banco de inversión Chanson & Co., con sede en Pekín. Una mayor debilidad en el tercer trimestre reforzaría las preocupaciones de los inversores sobre las perspectivas de crecimiento a largo plazo de Shein, señaló Shen. Las ventas de Shein en EE.UU. cayeron más de un 10% en los tres meses comprendidos entre agosto y principios de septiembre, según Bloomberg Second Measure, que analiza las transacciones con tarjetas de crédito y débito. Se trató de una caída más pronunciada que la contracción de un solo dígito registrada en la categoría más amplia del comercio minorista especializado en línea, señaló la fuente. Las ventas de Shein han registrado un rendimiento inferior al del sector de la confección en general en el país desde finales del año pasado. Mientras tanto, competidores como Temu, de PDD Holdings Inc. ( PDD ), y Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) han registrado un crecimiento de entre un dígito y dos dígitos desde abril. Dos proveedores clave en China comunicaron a Bloomberg que sus pedidos de Shein han descendido aproximadamente un 20% durante el tercer trimestre. Las caídas se agravaron en agosto y septiembre, según indicaron los proveedores, quienes solicitaron mantener el anonimato al hablar de sus relaciones comerciales con la empresa. Ver más: Acciones de Shein se desploman 10% tras su debut bursátil en Hong Kong Shein no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Otros indicadores apuntan a una creciente dificultad para atraer —y retener— a los compradores. El tráfico web global de Shein descendió en agosto con respecto al año anterior, lo que supone su primera contracción desde finales de 2024, según Similarweb. El tiempo dedicado a Shein también se redujo en más de un 10% en julio y agosto, mientras que las descargas de la aplicación se desplomaron más de un 40% en agosto, según Apptopia. Parte de esta debilidad podría reflejar un retroceso más generalizado del comercio electrónico. Los dos proveedores afirmaron que su negocio con Temu también se ha debilitado, mientras que el tráfico web global de la plataforma rival ha descendido desde marzo. El tiempo dedicado a Temu y a Amazon también disminuyó este verano. Temu no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Ver más: Shein, valorada en US$26.000 millones, aún genera dudas sobre su crecimiento Las presiones normativas y de costes se suman a los retos de Shein. Las nuevas tasas francesas sobre los artículos de moda ultrarrápida entraron en vigor el 1 de septiembre, mientras que la Unión Europea, un mercado clave, suprimió su exención de derechos de aduana “de minimis” a partir de julio. Los analistas de Bloomberg Intelligence, Catherine Lim y Jason Zhu, prevén que el crecimiento de los ingresos de Shein se ralentice hasta situarse en torno al 2,5% en 2026 y que el beneficio operativo ajustado caiga más de un 19%, ya que el aumento de los costes del petróleo y del transporte, vinculado a la guerra de Irán, reduce los márgenes. La gran incógnita es si este deterioro continuará. Las ventas del tercer trimestre serán “la prueba decisiva”, escribieron Lim y Zhu en una nota. -Con la colaboración de Amber Tong. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Jensen Huang's invisible hand is tied on AI safety
item.description: As a regulation debate rages, Nvidia's boss unveiled tools to monitor and shut down rogue agents. They should help rebuild some trust, but an accompanying $150 bln stock-buyback hike lays bare the financial incentives. A quest for rapid progress means self-policing isn't enough.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: As a regulation debate rages, Nvidia's boss unveiled tools to monitor and shut down rogue agents. They should help rebuild some trust, but an accompanying $150 bln stock-buyback hike lays bare the financial incentives. A quest for rapid progress means self-policing isn't enough. Full view will be published shortly. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . Nvidia on September 28 unveiled tools it says will prevent AI agents from acting in an unauthorized manner and could have prevented the Hugging Face attack by OpenAI agents. One product is OpenShell, which limits actions AI agents can take and what they can access. It is open source and runs on hardware from both Nvidia and other manufacturers. The other is Sentry, which Nvidia says monitors what happens in OpenShell and shuts down an agent quickly if it is drifting from its intended task or operating constraints. Sentry runs on Nvidia Bluefield processing units. Nvidia also said on September 28 that its board authorized a $150 billion increase to its existing share repurchase program, bringing it to $235 billion. The company plans to complete the buybacks by the end of its 2028 fiscal year on January 31, 2028. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Suppletive a Reggio Calabria, vince candidato centrodestra, nessun effetto Vannacci
item.description: Il centrodestra ha vinto le elezioni suppletive di Reggio Calabria, in un test politico seguito con attenzione anche per valutare l'impatto di Roberto Vannacci sugli equilibri della coalizione di governo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il centrodestra ha vinto le elezioni suppletive di Reggio Calabria, in un test politico seguito con attenzione anche per valutare l'impatto di Roberto Vannacci sugli equilibri della coalizione di governo. "Il centrodestra si conferma unito anche nelle suppletive di Reggio Calabria", ha scritto su X la presidente del Consiglio Giorgia Meloni, facendo i complimenti a Roscioli. Il voto serviva per assegnare il seggio della Camera lasciato libero dopo l'elezione a sindaco di Francesco Cannizzaro. Con 384 sezioni scrutinate su 487, Fabio Roscioli è avanti con il 52,47% dei voti, davanti a Frank Benedetto del centrosinistra al 36,11%, mentre Domenico Giannetta, candidato di Futuro Nazionale sostenuto da Vannacci, è al 10,04%. L'affluenza definitiva si è fermata al 22,34%.

item.title: Italy's Meloni passes by-election test against new far-right rival
item.description: Italy's ruling coalition won a closely watched by-election in the southern region of Calabria on Monday, the first major test for Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni against a new far-right foe ahead of a general election due next year.
item.dc:creator: Angelo Amante
item.content:encoded: Italy's ruling coalition won a closely watched by-election in the southern region of Calabria on Monday, the first major test for Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni against a new far-right foe ahead of a general election due next year. [USN:L1N44T0CD TEXT:"National Future"], led by former army general Roberto Vannacci, has surged to around 9% in opinion polls since its launch in February, overtaking Meloni's junior coalition partners and challenging the right in the conservative constituency of Reggio Calabria. However, the party's bid fell short, with the government candidate taking about 53% of the vote, while Vannacci's nominee secured roughly 10%, according to a partial count. Analysts had predicted a stronger showing for Vannacci in a traditionally rightist stronghold, saying he might have split the right-wing vote and handed victory to the centre-left. "We won by a landslide," Roberto Occhiuto, governor of Calabria and deputy leader of the coalition party Forza Italia, said in a video posted on X. AI-MANIPULATED IMAGE Support for Vannacci has grown nationwide on the back of his [USN:L8N44V0OK TEXT:"anti-migrant rhetoric"] and calls for what he describes as traditional Italian values. His rise has unsettled Meloni and could complicate her re-election prospects, drawing away voters who backed her coalition at the last national ballot in 2022. Pollsters have said she could keep hold of power if she forged an alliance with Vannacci. But any such tie-up would cause tension within government ranks. Parliament undersecretary Matilde Siracusano, a Forza Italia lawmaker and Occhiuto's partner, warned that any electoral pact with National Future would pose "a serious problem". She has said she will sue Vannacci after he posted an AI-generated image on social media showing her wearing a revealing, low-cut top. The centre-left candidate in the by-election won about 35% of the vote, improving on the bloc's performance in 2022, although turnout was just 22% against 49.4% four years ago. "With turnout extremely low, strong media attention and a candidate with significant personal backing, I believe Vannacci expected a far better showing," said Lorenzo Pregliasco, the head of polling firm YouTrend. Vannacci himself did not immediately comment on the result.

item.title: Nvidia settles trademark lawsuit over 'Modulus' AI software
item.description: Nvidia has settled a trademark lawsuit brought by financial technology company Modulus Financial Engineering over Nvidia's "Modulus" AI software, according to a filing in Austin, Texas federal court.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) has settled a trademark lawsuit brought by financial technology company Modulus Financial Engineering over Nvidia's "Modulus" AI software, according to a filing in Austin, Texas federal court. The companies told the court on Friday that they have resolved their dispute and asked to pause the case while they finalize their agreement Spokespeople for the companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment and more details on the settlement on Monday Modulus Financial [USN:L2N3GH16E TEXT:"filed the lawsuit"] in 2024, alleging that Nvidia's Modulus open-source software for developing AI machine-learning models would confuse consumers Scottsdale, Arizona-based Modulus Financial has provided financial software to companies including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Goldman Sachs since 1997, according to its website, and its lawsuit said it has "become widely recognized for its leadership and innovation — including within the field of A.I." Nvidia denied the allegations and said in a court filing earlier this year that it changed its software's name to "Nvidia PhysicsNeMo" in 2025 The case had been scheduled to go to trial next month The case is Modulus Financial Engineering Inc v. Nvidia Corp, US District Court for the Western District of Texas, No. 1:24-cv-00362. For Modulus: Robert Thornburg of Allen Dyer Doppelt + Gilchrist For Nvidia: John Desmarais of Desmarais LLP Read more: [USN:L2N3GH16E TEXT:"Nvidia hit with trademark lawsuit over 'Modulus' AI software"]

item.title: Legrand raises mid-term targets on data centre growth
item.description: French electrical and digital building infrastructure group Legrand raised its medium-term targets on Monday, driven by a stronger-than-expected growth in its data centre business.
item.dc:creator: Mathias Rozario, Rihab Latrache
item.content:encoded: French electrical and digital building infrastructure group Legrand (LEGD.PA) raised its medium-term targets on Monday, driven by a stronger-than-expected growth in its data centre business. Legrand, which operates across the commercial, industrial and residential sectors, has been outpacing the 2030 goals since it announced them in 2024, thanks to soaring demand for data centres, which account for a growing share of its revenue, CEO Benoit Coquart told Reuters. It now expects average organic revenue growth of 6% to 8% per year between 2027 and 2030, up from the 3% to 5% range it had forecast for 2025-2030. It also sees an adjusted operating margin averaging between 21% and 22% of total sales, versus around 20% in the previous guidance. Coquart expects the sector's boom to continue in the coming years, saying Legrand's clients are bolstering their AI investment plans even as some AI leaders [USN:L1N45403R TEXT:"urge developers"] to slow the development of advanced models. "We currently have 80 gigawatts of installed capacity in data centres for IT, and we believe that by 2030, this will rise to 180," Coquart said in an interview ahead of Tuesday's Capital Markets Day. The group expects the share of turnover generated by its historical building business to shrink, while the energy and digital transition business, which includes data centre infrastructure and energy management solutions, is set to grow from 53% of its total revenue in 2025 to around 70% by 2030. "There are three factors: acquisitions, which will mainly be in the energy and digital transition sectors; the divestment, which will take place in the core business; and, quite simply, the different rates of organic growth," Coquart said. Legrand expects its construction business to return to moderate growth of between 1% and 3% in Europe. The situation is slightly less positive in the US for both residential and commercial business areas, he added.

item.title: U.S. stocks drop after oil prices and bond yields crank higher
item.description: Surging crude prices are dragging on U.S. futures after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — Rising oil prices are knocking the U.S. stock market further from its record high on Monday, while building pressure even higher within the U.S. bond market. The S&P 500 fell 0.8 per cent and gave back most of its gains from last week, which had brought it to the brink of its all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 372 points, or 0.7 per cent, as of 11:45 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 1 per cent lower. Most of the U.S. stock market sank under the weight of a 2.8 per cent rise for the most actively traded contract in the market for Brent crude oil to US$100.19 per barrel. That overshadowed a gain for Wall Street’s most influential stock, Nvidia, after it announced a historic funneling of cash to its investors through a buyback of its shares. Oil prices have been yo-yoing on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow tankers to flow freely again through the Strait of Hormuz and deliver oil from the Middle East to customers worldwide. The latest turns came after President Donald Trump said over the weekend he’s rejecting an offer from Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume talks on its nuclear program. “I’d like to make a deal, too,” Trump said Saturday. “But that deal would not be acceptable.” Brent climbed above US$101 per barrel Monday morning, before the U.S. stock market opened for trading, but it pared its gains as U.S. officials said mediators were still working with Iran and the United States on a deal to end the fighting and open the strait. For all its ups and downs, a barrel of Brent remains much higher than the roughly US$72 it cost before the United States and Israel attacked Iran in late February. That has helped worsen inflation, and the average price for a gallon of regular gasoline is up to nearly US$4.48 from US$3.13 a year ago, according to AAA. Worries about inflation have in turn helped send Treasury yields much higher in the bond market. That pressures the economy because it makes borrowing money more expensive for everyone, while also undercutting prices for stocks and other investments. The yield on the 10-year Treasury, which is the centerpiece of the bond market, jumped to 5.26 per cent from 5.17 per cent late Friday. That’s a considerable move for the bond market, and the 10-year yield is back to where it was in 2007, before the financial crisis and Great Recession sent yields toward zero. The 30-year Treasury yield, which leaped to 5.58 per cent from 5.49 per cent, is back to where it was in 2004. On Wall Street, stocks of airlines and other companies with big fuel bills sank because of the rise in oil prices. American Airlines fell 3.8 per cent, and United Airlines lost 3.6 per cent. Gold miners were also weak after the price of gold sank 3.9 per cent. Gold has a reputation for helping to protect its investors from high inflation, but its price tends to weaken when yields are rising and causing bonds to pay their investors more in interest. Gold struggles to keep up because it pays its investors nothing. Newmont, the Denver-based mining giant, sank 4.4 per cent. One of Wall Street’s bigger losses hit MongoDB, which dropped 18.5 per cent after the database company said its CEO, Chirantan “CJ” Desai, is stepping down immediately to pursue a senior role at Meta Platforms. Such losses helped more than offset a 2 per cent rise for Nvidia. The chip company said it approved a plan to send up to another US$150 billion to its shareholders in a stock buyback plan, bringing the program’s total remaining size to US$235 billion. Nvidia has the power to do so after the frenzy around its chips used for artificial-intelligence technology helped it more than double the amount of cash on its books in the first half of its fiscal year. The company also on Monday unveiled a new security platform that the chipmaker said can stop artificial intelligence agents from going rogue. AI stocks broadly have come under pressure after leaders of the industry said it needs to slow its development to give safety measures time to catch up. In stock markets abroad, European indexes were mixed following weaker performances across much of Asia. Indexes dropped 2.7 per cent in Seoul and 1.7 per cent in Shanghai for two of the world’s bigger moves. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

item.title: Energy Watch: Big Oil's big rethink
item.description: After a whirlwind of speeches, threats, peace overtures and a summit between the US and Chinese leaders in Washington last week, the US-Iran standoff remains pretty stagnant. But not entirely.
item.dc:creator: Ron Bousso
item.content:encoded: After a whirlwind of speeches, threats, peace overtures and a summit between the US and Chinese leaders in Washington last week, the US-Iran standoff remains pretty stagnant. But not entirely. Oil prices [USN:L4N45J03L TEXT:"rebounded"] by around 3% to above $107 a barrel on Monday morning after President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45I080 TEXT:"rejected a peace deal"] from Iran that would have reopened the Strait of Hormuz. While this has again dashed hopes of a breakthrough, oil flows through the critical waterway [USN:L1N45J07E TEXT:"have grown steadily"] in recent weeks, suggesting that both sides are for now comfortable with the status quo. Elevated oil prices are stoking concerns of persistently higher global inflation, increasing expectations that central banks will push up interest rates. Government [USN:L6N45F0LQ TEXT:"bond yields"] last week soared to new multi-decade highs, aggravated by hot US business activity data and rising government debt concerns. The energy and financial markets also continue to question whether the Trump administration will impose a ban on diesel exports in the coming weeks in an attempt to lower soaring diesel prices, which rose above $6.50 a gallon ahead of the November midterm elections. After holding talks with American refiners last week, the administration seems to be searching for [USN:L1N45G0Q3 TEXT:"an alternative to a short-term ban"]. The possibility of a ban is already having an impact on the market, as the [USN:L6N45G0YB TEXT:"gap between US crude oil futures"] and the global Brent benchmark has widened, a signal that markets expect US refiners to process less crude oil if their diesel output gets stuck at home. Exactly seven months since the start of the Mideast conflict, the energy markets are slowly acknowledging that many of the war’s consequences could linger for far longer than initially anticipated. This is fundamentally changing the strategic calculus for the world’s oil and gas majors. [USN:L6N45H0N6 TEXT:"More on this in my latest column"]. In other news: Lower standards: The US Transportation Department on Monday will finalize [USN:FWN45I08D TEXT:"sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards"] through 2031, reversing a push by the Biden administration to force automakers to build more electric vehicles. Energy shock: The European Union is [USN:S8N42Q0E1 TEXT:"facing an energy price crisis"] as fallout from the Iran war roils oil and gas markets, EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jorgensen said in a letter seen by Reuters that urged countries to consider measures to curb natural gas demand. Gas shock: At the same time, the CEO of German gas importer VNG, Ulf Heitmueller, said that even though Europe’s biggest economy is heading into winter with unusually low natural gas stocks, it faces [USN:L8N45G0QN TEXT:"no immediate supply risk"] thanks to a broader and more resilient import portfolio than during the 2022 energy crisis. AI trading boom: The Iran conflict has put a spotlight on the murky world of refined fuel trading as the world battles constrained supply and record-high prices. But AI may bring the trading of diesel, gasoline and other products out of the shadows for good, [USN:L1N45G07L TEXT:"explains ROI Asia Commodities Columnist Clyde Russell"]. As ever, don't hesitate to contact me at ron.bousso@thomsonreuters.com or follow me on LinkedIn with any questions or thoughts. Subscribe to get Ron Bousso's Power Up newsletter delivered to your inbox every Monday and Thursday. Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: French far-right leader Bardella denies media claim he made antisemitic remarks
item.description: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Monday denied a report by investigative website Mediapart alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, calling the allegations "crude fabrications".
item.dc:creator: Michel Rose
item.content:encoded: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Monday denied a report by investigative website Mediapart alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, calling the allegations "crude fabrications". The report comes as Bardella's far-right National Rally (RN) party, whose presidential candidate Marine Le Pen is leading polls ahead of next year's election, seeks to clear its racist image and build close ties with Israel. "I formally dispute the accusations against me by Mediapart, which attributes to me deranged and antisemitic remarks that I supposedly made when I was a minor. These are obviously crude forgeries," Bardella wrote on X. He said he had instructed his lawyer to pursue "all necessary proceedings" against Mediapart. Mediapart, in a report published on Monday, said it had reviewed dozens of private messages from 2013-2015 - the early years of Bardella's career in the National Front, the forerunner of the RN - that it said showed a pattern of antisemitic and conspiratorial rhetoric. Mediapart cited one message in which it said Bardella claimed "all the banks are owned by Jews". The left-leaning outlet, which has a long history of unearthing political scandals in France, said it had independently authenticated the private messages, and had also drawn on testimony from former party colleagues, which it named with first names and the initial of their last names. Bardella, 31, has become the face of the RN's decade-long effort to "de-demonise", or normalise, its image. He was the party's de facto presidential candidate until July, when an appeals court cleared Le Pen to run for the presidency, and will be France's prime minister if she wins next year's vote. Le Pen, speaking with reporters on Monday, said she believed the report could "only be a fake, a manipulation, a dirty trick". She said she expected Bardella to file an imminent defamation lawsuit, adding she had nothing to discuss with her young protege. A Monday poll showed her coming first in next April's first round vote and beating both leftist and centrist candidates in a May runoff. A slew of antisemitic, Islamophobic and racist comments by some RN candidates derailed the party's hopes of winning a parliamentary majority in France's legislative vote in 2024. Bardella at the time pledged to avoid such "casting errors" in the future by systematically kicking out any candidates with a history of toxic statements.

item.title: 韓国、ウクライナ代理大使に抗議 北朝鮮の捕虜移送公表に
item.description:
Heekyong Yang Jack Kim
[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Heekyong Yang　Jack Kim

[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は２８日、北朝鮮兵捕虜の韓国への移送をウクライナ側が公表したことを受け、在韓国ウクライナ大使館のアンドリー・ベシキン代理大使を呼び出して抗議した。公式な説明と謝罪も求めた。両国間で非公表とするとの明確な合意があったと主張。ウクライナに対し、強い遺憾の意を表明したと述べた。

ゼレンスキー大統領は先週の国連総会の演説で、ロシア側として戦って捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に引き渡したと述べていた。韓国大統領府も２７日、ウクライナに対して公式な説明と謝罪を要求していた。

韓国外務省は、非公表とする合意はなかったとするウクライナ大統領府の説明についても「虚偽の声明」だとして抗議し、再発防止のための措置を講じるよう求めたと表明。

韓国メディアの報道によると、ベシキン氏は韓国の立場を正確に伝えると述べたという。

トランプ米大統領はこのところ、北朝鮮との対話への意欲を見せ、韓国も支持する考えを示している。

item.title: カタール仲介団、米・イランと個別協議へ 戦争終結目指す
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２８日 ロイター] - カタールの仲介団が２８日か２９日に、ニューヨークでイランのアラグチ外相と、また別途米国側と協議する見通しだと、交渉について説明を受けた当局者がロイターに明らかにした。戦争終結に向けた新たな取り組みとなる。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた同当局者によると、協議では、イランが先週、国連総会に合わせて提示した７日間の計画の修正案が焦点となる見通し。

アラグチ氏は国連総会への出席後もニューヨークに滞在している。仲介団との協議に米国側から誰が出席するかは、現時点では不明。

イランの準国営ＩＳＮＡ通信はその後、アラグチ氏がニューヨーク時間２８日午前に米国で仲介団と会談すると確認した。双方は「現状に関する最新の提案や見解を検討する」という。

一方、イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は２８日、その後国営メディアに対し、アラグチ氏のニューヨーク滞在は延長されておらず、当初の予定通りテヘランに戻ると述べた。仲介団との協議についてはコメントしなかった。

＜トランプ氏、今週の追加協議を示唆＞

イランの７日間の計画は、イランとレバノンでの全ての敵対行為の停止、数十億ドル相当のイラン資産の凍結解除、イラン産原油に対する制裁の解除、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖の解除を想定している。

その上でイランはホルムズ海峡の再開を認め、米国とイランはイランの核開発計画を巡る協議も再開する。

トランプ米大統領は２６日、イランの提案を拒否したと表明。イランは深刻な経済的圧力にさらされているため、早期の合意を望んでいると述べた。

ただ、２７日には米ニュースサイトのアクシオスに対し、米交渉団が今週、さらなる協議に臨むとの見通しも示した。

item.title: Denmark send injured Dorgu back to Man United
item.description: Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has been sent back from international duty after picking up an injury while playing for Denmark in their 2-0 win over Wales in the Nations League on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has been sent back from international duty after picking up an injury while playing for Denmark in their 2-0 win over Wales in the Nations League on Sunday. The versatile 21-year-old, who can play as a left winger, left back or wing back, was forced off during the first half, appearing to hold the back of his thigh. “He has an injury and has to go home. A new one has to be called in," Denmark coach Brian Riemer told TV2. Dorgu has appeared in all five of United's Premier League games this season. He came on as a late substitute and assisted Matheus Cunha's equaliser as United drew [USN:L1N45C055 TEXT:"1-1 at Fulham"] in their last game before the international break.

item.title: Meta contrata presidente da MongoDB para impulsionar iniciativa de IA corporativa
item.description: A Meta contratou o presidente-executivo da MongoDB , Chirantan “CJ” Desai, para liderar um novo negócio destinado a levar as ferramentas de inteligência artificial da companhia de mídia social a clientes corporativos.
item.dc:creator: Harshita Varghese
item.content:encoded: A Meta (META.O) contratou o presidente-executivo da MongoDB (MDB.O) , Chirantan “CJ” Desai, para liderar um novo negócio destinado a levar as ferramentas de inteligência artificial da companhia de mídia social a clientes corporativos. As ações da fornecedora de software de banco de dados despencaram 18% nesta segunda-feira, já que Desai está deixando o cargo após menos de um ano como presidente-executivo. Desai, um executivo veterano da área de tecnologia, assumiu o cargo no lugar de Dev Ittycheria. A MongoDB nomeou Ittycheria como presidente-executivo interino enquanto procura um substituto permanente. “Embora a saída seja decepcionante, acreditamos que a MongoDB continua bem posicionada estrategicamente e consideramos a reação do preço das ações exagerada”, afirmou a corretora Piper Sandler em uma nota. A Meta anunciou nesta segunda-feira que levará seus modelos de IA, agentes e ferramentas para as empresas por meio da nova Meta Enterprise Platform, incluindo o recém-lançado Muse, o Meta Business Agent e ferramentas de programação. A empresa lançou o Muse no início deste mês, um agente pessoal de IA projetado para realizar tarefas como fazer compras, reservar viagens, enviar emails e efetuar pagamentos em nome dos usuários. O Muse subiu rapidamente nos rankings da App Store da Apple e do Google Play nas últimas semanas e foi descrito por analistas como potencialmente o maior lançamento de aplicativo nos EUA desde o ChatGPT, em novembro de 2022, que ajudou a dar início ao boom da IA. Desai se reportará diretamente ao presidente-executivo da Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, no cargo recém-criado de diretor de plataforma empresarial, e se concentrará em transformar a IA da companhia em produtos e serviços que as empresas possam implantar em seus próprios negócios. Antes de ingressar na MongoDB, Desai liderou as áreas de produto e engenharia na Cloudflare (NET.N) e passou quase oito anos na ServiceNow (NOW.N) , inclusive como presidente e diretor de operações. A MongoDB fornece software de banco de dados utilizado por empresas para desenvolver e executar aplicativos, com ferramentas para gerenciamento de dados, pesquisa, análise e IA.

item.title: Boston sues Trump administration after grant nixed over EV support
item.description: The city of Boston sued on Monday to challenge the Trump administration's rescission of a $20 million federal grant for a streets improvement project, citing plans to install electric vehicle charging stations as a reason for the cancellation.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: The city of Boston sued on Monday to challenge the Trump administration's rescission of a $20 million federal grant for a streets improvement project, citing plans to install electric vehicle charging stations as a reason for the cancellation. The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Massachusetts, says the charging stations represented less than 1% of the project's cost and that the city offered to remove them, but the department refused to restore the funding. The lawsuit is the second by a city challenging the US Department of Transportation's cancellation of grants, [USN:L1N2SA092 TEXT:"issued under a program"] called Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE). The program was funded through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, former Democratic President Joe Biden's signature 2021 law to address climate change. The Department of Transportation in a statement on Monday said it is reviewing the lawsuit and "remains committed to ensuring that taxpayer dollars are spent wisely and in ways that benefit all Americans." The department in September 2025 terminated several RAISE grants that had funded projects nationwide, including pedestrian safety improvements, bike lanes and other transportation upgrades. Boston received its $20 million grant in 2022 for a nearly $34 million project to redesign three heavily traveled streets in the populous neighborhood of Roxbury. The project included roadway repairs, wider sidewalks and measures to speed bus service for commuters. "Boston earned this competitive grant to meet community needs and address long-needed infrastructure upgrades," Boston Mayor Michelle Wu, a Democrat, said in a statement. But the department under Trump withdrew the funding, saying the grant was "inconsistent" with its priorities because it would involve installing EV charging stations. The Trump administration has [USN:L1N3YO15Q TEXT:"pursued a series of policies"] aimed at boosting the sale of gas-powered vehicles and cutting EV incentives for automakers and consumers. Represented in part by the Public Rights Project, Boston argues the department lacked legal authority to cancel the grant on that basis and that it violated the Administrative Procedure Act and constitutional separation-of-powers principles by doing so. It says Congress did not authorize the department to rescind grants due to the inclusion of EV infrastructure and that underlying statutory criteria for the program prioritized projects that would improve environmental sustainability. The city of Albuquerque, New Mexico, last year filed a similar lawsuit, after the Department of Transportation withdrew an $11.5 million grant to support an urban trail project in the city's downtown. The department did so saying the project ran counter to its focus on promoting "vehicular travel." The lawsuit remains pending after recently surviving a motion to dismiss. The case is City of Boston v. Duffy et al, US District Court for the District of Massachusetts, No. 1:26-cv-14419. For Boston: Megan Corrigan of the City of Boston Law Department and Cassandra Crawford of the Public Rights Project Read more: [USN:L1N3YO15Q TEXT:"Trump administration unlawfully suspended EV charger infrastructure program, US judge rules"]

item.title: Russia says it hit cargo vessels bound for Ukraine, telecoms infrastructure in Kyiv
item.description: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Monday its forces had struck fuel and telecommunications infrastructure in Kyiv, as well as several cargo vessels that it alleged were supplying the Ukrainian military.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Monday its forces had struck fuel and telecommunications infrastructure in Kyiv, as well as several cargo vessels that it alleged were supplying the Ukrainian military. The ministry said the Russian strikes hit three cargo vessels bound for Odesa and another cargo vessel in the port of Chornomorsk. A ship repair facility in the port of Izmail was also struck, it added. The ministry said several data centres in Kyiv were hit in overnight and daytime attacks. Reuters could not independently verify the ministry's reports.

item.title: Ballroom donors will dance like someone's watching
item.description: Companies that have been cozy with President Trump, including by funding his $400 mln gilded event space, have started to squirm. Many, from Amazon to Kirkland & Ellis, are likely to face painful scrutiny if Democrats win the House in November. Capitol heat tends to fry CEOs.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Rubin
item.content:encoded: Business titans [USN:L6N45G1DV TEXT:"toasted"] Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington last week, and some will probably be back soon to be roasted. Democrats, giddy about November’s midterm elections, plan to use their congressional mantles to probe companies that have been cozy with the Trump administration. The oversight will be an onerous and costly distraction, and Capitol Hill has been the end of the line for many CEOs. With President Donald Trump’s approval rating languishing in the low 30% range, Republicans are already warning Corporate America about ballot-box repercussions. Investigative targets would include companies that contributed funds to the commander-in-chief's $400 million ballroom project and ones that had business dealings with his family. Representative Jamie Raskin , who is in line to run the House Judiciary Committee if Democrats win the chamber in November, has flagged what he calls systems of bribery, kickbacks and financial corruption. E-commerce powerhouse Amazon (AMZN.O) , cable operator Comcast (CMCSA.O) and software goliath Microsoft (MSFT.O) are among the publicly named corporate donors to Trump's White House renovation project already scrambling to explain themselves. Law firms that struck deals with the Oval Office to preserve security clearances and government contracts or which have otherwise advised the administration, including Kirkland & Ellis, also would be in the political crossfire. The AI, defense , semiconductor, mining and energy industries may be scrutinized for federal grant and loan money they received. Complying with such investigations is often time-consuming and expensive, even before subpoenas arrive. Document requests, internal audits and retention of crisis-PR teams and outside legal counsel all suck up valuable resources. Even highly coached bosses falter in the glare, too. Wells Fargo (WFC.N) CEO John Stumpf stepped down a decade ago soon after he endured two congressional grillings over a fake-accounts scandal at the mega-bank. Boeing's (BA.N) Dave Calhoun told Congress in 2024 he would see through a safety crisis after one Republican senator asked why he was still in his job; he was gone by the end of the year. Mark Zuckerberg has greater job security by virtue of his voting control over $1.8 trillion Meta Platforms, but his 2018 hearing before Senate Judiciary, Commerce and Energy committees marked a turning point in the debate over self-policing social media. When US government power is divided, and legislative prospects bleakest, such inquiries get a lot of attention. Rather than try and impeach a president who cannot run again, political capital will be devoted instead to examining those companies and individuals perceived to have engaged in and enabled wrongdoing. Captains of industry and their shareholders should be braced to pay a price. Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn . House Democrats preparing for a possible return to power after the US November midterm elections are developing a broad investigative strategy targeting companies that have had dealings with President Donald Trump. item.title: El BCE estudia nuevas medidas de protección monetaria para reforzar el papel del euro
item.description: El Banco Central Europeo tiene previsto ampliar las redes de seguridad monetarias para facilitar a los bancos centrales extranjeros la obtención de préstamos en euros, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde, en un intento por reforzar la posición global de la moneda única.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central Europeo tiene previsto ampliar las redes de seguridad monetarias para facilitar a los bancos centrales extranjeros la obtención de préstamos en euros, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde, en un intento por reforzar la posición global de la moneda única. La iniciativa surge en un contexto de preocupación por la fragmentación financiera y la creciente incertidumbre en torno al futuro del dólar estadounidense bajo el mandato del presidente Donald Trump. Lagarde señaló que el BCE trabajará en las líneas de swap, que actúan como fuente de liquidez de emergencia en momentos de crisis al permitir a los bancos centrales extranjeros obtener préstamos en euros a cambio de su propia moneda. "Trabajaremos en líneas de swap que respondan mejor a la necesidad imperiosa de contar con una zona del euro soberana y un euro fuerte", dijo Lagarde a legisladores europeos. Las líneas de swap alivian la presión sobre los prestatarios extranjeros, pero también evitan que la tensión en el extranjero se extienda a la zona del euro. El BCE mantiene acuerdos de este tipo con la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos y con los bancos centrales de Japón, el Reino Unido, Canadá y Suiza. La medida forma parte del esfuerzo continuo del BCE por ampliar la presencia internacional del euro. El BCE ha recibido cerca de 30 solicitudes para una línea de crédito independiente —conocida como acuerdos de recompra o "repo"— que permite a los bancos extranjeros obtener préstamos a cambio de garantías en euros. A los responsables de los bancos centrales y a los inversionistas les preocupa que la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos pueda acabar recortando sus propias líneas de swap, que actualmente constituyen el principal salvavidas global para billones de dólares en préstamos extranjeros.

item.title: Dinamarca prevé una presencia a largo plazo de la OTAN en Groenlandia tras acuerdo con Trump
item.description: Dinamarca confía en que la OTAN mantenga una presencia reforzada en Groenlandia y en toda la región ártica por un largo tiempo, tras el acuerdo de seguridad firmado la semana pasada con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el ministro de Defensa danés.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Gray
item.content:encoded: Dinamarca confía en que la OTAN mantenga una presencia reforzada en Groenlandia y en toda la región ártica por un largo tiempo, tras el acuerdo de seguridad firmado la semana pasada con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el ministro de Defensa danés. La OTAN puso en marcha a principios de este año una misión denominada "Arctic Sentry" para intensificar los ejercicios y las patrullas en la región, como parte de un esfuerzo por calmar la fuerte tensión dentro de la alianza militar a raíz de la intención del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de adquirir Groenlandia. En una entrevista con Reuters en Bruselas, el ministro de Defensa danés, Jeppe Bruus, dijo que Copenhague esperaba que "Arctic Sentry" continue después de este año y del próximo para convertirse en una misión permanente. Cuando se le preguntó si había recibido señales claras de los aliados de la OTAN de que están interesados, Bruus respondió: "Hasta ahora estamos bastante seguros de que la mayor presencia militar en Groenlandia —pero también en el Ártico— continuará". El acuerdo, firmado por Trump y los líderes de Dinamarca y Groenlandia en las Naciones Unidas la semana pasada, prevé que Estados Unidos añada dos bases más a la que ya tiene en el territorio ártico danés semiautónomo. Pero también considera un papel más importante para la OTAN. Bruus señaló que dicho papel sería importante, ya que el deshielo provocado por el cambio climático abre nuevas rutas marítimas en el Ártico. "El creciente interés por el Ártico, también por parte de Rusia, China y otros, exige que la OTAN tenga una mayor presencia en el Alto Norte", agregó.

item.title: Trump's AI meeting with tech CEOs to focus on finding balance, US House speaker says
item.description: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology.
item.dc:creator: Katharine Jackson
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology. "We do not need a moratorium. We do not need to jump in and hyper-regulate this, because we'll lose the race to China," Johnson said in an interview on Monday with Fox Business Network. "The innovation is important to continue, but we have to strike the right balance. That's what the conversation is going to be about." The White House meeting, which will include Johnson, comes as leading AI companies are calling for slowing development of increasingly capable AI systems, warning of the risks to humanity and appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology. Trump has downplayed concerns over the misuse of artificial intelligence harming people as he stressed the importance of maintaining America's competitive edge over China. He says the US already has [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"guardrails in place"] for the powerful technology, including at the Department of Justice. Johnson said the US should be mindful of safety but not stymie the technology's development. "I think there may be a role for the DOJ if things go awry. But what we need before we get to that stage is transparency, and we need some oversight," he said on "Mornings with Fox Business." [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"Lawmakers"] in both parties have questioned Trump's hands-off approach even as the technology raises fears about safety, job losses and the concentration of power among a handful of tech companies. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries said AI industry leaders were pleading for some government action and Congress has a responsibility to protect the American people. "So, when it comes to AI safety, it certainly seems to me that we need to actually lean in boldly and responsibly — now," Jeffries told CNBC on Monday. The president had dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Sunday. Anthropic and its rivals have called for slowing AI development. These include OpenAI, Google’s (GOOGL.O) DeepMind, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and xAI.

item.title: Lagarde für "maßvolle" Reaktion auf Inflation - Zinsschritt im Dezember?
item.description: Die EZB will laut ihrer Präsidentin Christine Lagarde mit Augenmaß auf die vom Iran-Krieg angeheizte Inflation reagieren. Diese bewege sich auf einem "mittleren" Pfad, der von der Europäischen Zentralbank lediglich maßvolle Zinserhöhungen erfordere, betonte sie am Montag bei einer Anhörung vor einem Ausschuss des Europäischen Parlaments. Die EZB erwarte zwar eine höhere Inflation, sehe aber bislang keine Anzeichen dafür, dass sie sich verfestige: "Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt sehen wir keine Belege dafür, dass sich die Energiepreise auf die Löhne übertragen." Mit den Äußerungen wurden Zinsfantasien an den Finanzmärkten gedämpft. Dort gilt eine Erhöhung auf der EZB-Ratssitzung Ende Oktober als weniger wahrscheinlich. Eine Zinsanhebung im Dezember ist hingegen eingepreist.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die EZB will laut ihrer Präsidentin Christine Lagarde mit Augenmaß auf die vom Iran-Krieg angeheizte Inflation reagieren. Diese bewege sich auf einem "mittleren" Pfad, der von der Europäischen Zentralbank lediglich maßvolle Zinserhöhungen erfordere, betonte sie am Montag bei einer Anhörung vor einem Ausschuss des Europäischen Parlaments. Die EZB erwarte zwar eine höhere Inflation, sehe aber bislang keine Anzeichen dafür, dass sie sich verfestige: "Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt sehen wir keine Belege dafür, dass sich die Energiepreise auf die Löhne übertragen." Mit den Äußerungen wurden Zinsfantasien an den Finanzmärkten gedämpft. Dort gilt eine Erhöhung auf der EZB-Ratssitzung Ende Oktober als weniger wahrscheinlich. Eine Zinsanhebung im Dezember ist hingegen eingepreist. Lagarde bekräftigte vor dem Ausschuss, dass sich die Zinsen "nicht im Gleichschritt" mit den Energiepreisen bewegten. Die [USN:L8N4590LJ TEXT:"Inflationsrate"] ist im August im Euroraum auf 3,2 Prozent gestiegen und liegt damit deutlich über dem Zielwert der EZB von 2,0 Prozent. Energie erwies sich dabei als Preistreiber Nummer eins: Sie verteuerte sich um 14,3 Prozent zum Vorjahresmonat. INFLATION AUF DEM VORMARSCH Für September halten Volkswirte ein weiteres Anziehen der Teuerungsrate im Euroraum auf 3,6 Prozent für möglich. Wegen des Iran-Krieges und der damit verbundenen höheren Benzin- und Gaspreise rechnen manche Experten bis zum Jahresende sogar mit einem Anstieg auf vier Prozent. Die führenden Wirtschaftsforschungsinstitute erwarten in ihrem [USN:L8N45G0CS TEXT:"Herbstgutachten"], dass es Ende des Jahres einen weiteren Zinsschritt der EZB nach oben geben wird. Bei einer Erhöhung um einen Viertelpunkt dürfte der für die Geldpolitik relevante Einlagensatz dann bei 2,75  Prozent liegen. Die EZB hatte den Leitzins im Kampf gegen die vom Ölpreisschock infolge des Iran-Krieges angeheizte Inflation im September zum zweiten Mal in diesem Jahr angehoben.

item.title: Florida solicita a corte prohibición de nuevos modelos de OpenAI en demanda por daños a menores
item.description: El fiscal general de Florida solicitó el lunes a un juez que impida a OpenAI desarrollar nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial sin supervisión externa, en el marco de una demanda en la que se acusa a la empresa de causar daño a los menores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El fiscal general de Florida solicitó el lunes a un juez que impida a OpenAI desarrollar nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial sin supervisión externa, en el marco de una demanda en la que se acusa a la empresa de causar daño a los menores. Florida demandó a OpenAI en junio acusando a la empresa de falsear la seguridad de su plataforma ChatGPT, alegando que ha perjudicado a los niños al proporcionar información a autores de tiroteos en colegios, ofrecer orientación sobre autolesiones y crear adicción entre los usuarios jóvenes. El fiscal general de Florida, James Uthmeier, solicitó también en el escrito presentado el lunes que el tribunal ordene a OpenAI impedir el acceso de menores a ChatGPT y prohíba a la empresa dotar a su plataforma de chat de "atributos humanos". Un portavoz de OpenAI no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

item.title: Países da UE aprovam cinco grandes projetos pan-europeus de defesa
item.description: Os países-membros da União Europeia aprovaram nesta segunda-feira planos para cinco projetos pan-europeus de defesa que abrangem medidas de defesa espacial, marítima, aérea e contra drones, os quais agora serão elegíveis para financiamento da UE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os países-membros da União Europeia aprovaram nesta segunda-feira planos para cinco projetos pan-europeus de defesa que abrangem medidas de defesa espacial, marítima, aérea e contra drones, os quais agora serão elegíveis para financiamento da UE. Os Projetos Europeus de Defesa de Interesse Comum (EDPCIs) permitem que os países europeus trabalhem em conjunto em grandes iniciativas de defesa que seriam grandes ou complexas demais para serem desenvolvidas por um único Estado da UE, informou o Conselho da União Europeia em comunicado anunciando as aprovações. Os cinco projetos que receberam aprovação para financiamento concentram-se no desenvolvimento de táticas de combate a drones e de defesa contra drones, bem como na proteção do flanco oriental da Europa. Originalmente propostos pela Comissão Europeia em julho, eles também incluem um projeto integrado de defesa marítima e do leito marinho, um projeto de defesa aérea e antimísseis e de alerta antecipado e um projeto de defesa espacial. “Trabalhando em estreita colaboração com nossos parceiros, a Noruega e a Ucrânia, juntos estamos tomando medidas decisivas para proteger o espaço, nossos céus, nossos mares, os cabos submarinos e nossos cidadãos que dependem deles”, afirmou Helen McEntee, ministra da Defesa da Irlanda — que detém a presidência rotativa do Conselho —, em um comunicado. No âmbito do Programa Europeu da Indústria de Defesa do bloco, um orçamento de 325 milhões de euros (US$370 milhões) está destinado às EDPCIs, com a possibilidade de mais recursos serem disponibilizados no futuro. (Reportagem de Mateusz Rabiega)

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Centro de Seguridad del Gobierno de Polonia levantó el lunes una advertencia que había emitido minutos antes en que alertaba a los residentes de la región oriental de Lublin que buscaran un lugar seguro debido a los ataques rusos contra la vecina Ucrania. "ATENCIÓN!. La amenaza de ataque aéreo ha sido levantada. No hay una amenaza dentro del territorio de Polonia", aseguró el centro. Anteriormente había anunciado que aviones polacos estaban operando en el espacio aéreo del país como consecuencia de los ataques rusos contra Ucrania.

item.title: Report: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for season
item.description: Miami Dolphins running back De'Von Achane will miss the rest of the season after tearing his left ACL in Sunday's loss to Kansas City, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miami Dolphins running back De'Von Achane will miss the rest of the season after tearing his left ACL in Sunday's loss to Kansas City, ESPN reported Monday. Achane, 24, sustained the knee injury on his third rushing attempt in the 24-10 setback against the Chiefs in Miami Gardens, Fla. He hobbled off the field after being tackled awkwardly by safety Alohi Gilman. "To be very honest with you, it does not sound very optimistic at this moment, but I can't give you any other details until I have them," Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said after the game. Achane finished with 17 yards rushing on three carries, and no receptions on one target. For the season, he has rushed for 127 yards on 34 attempts with no touchdowns in three games. He has seven catches for 49 yards and no scores. Second-year pro Ollie Gordon replaced Achane as the lead back for the Dolphins (0-3) and rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries. Achane posted career highs with 1,350 rushing yards and 1,838 yards from scrimmage and made his first Pro Bowl last season. A third-round pick by Miami in 2023, he has 4,510 yards from scrimmage and 35 touchdowns through 47 career games (39 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Ejecutivos petroleros asisten a conferencia en Venezuela y desatan búsqueda de palos de golf
item.description: Unos 650 ejecutivos locales y extranjeros, funcionarios de gobierno y diplomáticos asistirán a la Cumbre Internacional de Petróleo y Gas de Venezuela, que comienza el martes.
item.dc:creator: Patricia Garip
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Decenas de ejecutivos se dieron cita el lunes en el exuberante Caracas Country Club para un torneo de golf, antesala de una conferencia de petróleo y gas con entradas agotadas que se celebra esta semana en la capital venezolana. Días antes, los organizadores del evento estaban desesperados. “Contactamos a todos los clubes y tiendas de golf para encontrar palos”, dijo Alex Moulds, de la londinense Global Event Partners Ltd. “Pedimos prestados algunos juegos e incluso compramos unos cuantos para asegurarnos de tener suficientes”. Ver más: El nuevo pulso petrolero de Venezuela busca encender algo más que los pozos Para el venezolano promedio, la carrera por conseguir palos de golf dentro de la burbuja adinerada de Caracas parece un problema casi absurdo: durante años han soportado contracción económica, hiperinflación y sanciones que empobrecieron al país rico en petróleo. Venezuela también se recupera de dos terremotos que dejaron miles de muertos en junio. Sin embargo, la conferencia encaja con la promesa del presidente Donald Trump de devolverle a Venezuela su antigua gloria bajo el paraguas de la influencia de EE.UU. Trump, golfista habitual y propietario de varios campos en distintos países, se propuso canalizar US$100.000 millones para reactivar la industria petrolera venezolana después de que fuerzas de EE.UU. depusieran a Nicolás Maduro en enero. La conferencia de esta semana es hasta ahora el intento de mayor perfil por avanzar hacia ese objetivo. Unos 650 ejecutivos locales y extranjeros, funcionarios de gobierno y diplomáticos asistirán a la Cumbre Internacional de Petróleo y Gas de Venezuela, que comienza el martes, mientras más de 150 personas están en lista de espera. La avalancha refleja el renovado atractivo de Venezuela para la industria de los hidrocarburos en momentos en que la guerra restringe los suministros de Medio Oriente. Entre las empresas representadas figuran ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. ( XOM ), TotalEnergies SE ( TTE ), BP Plc ( BP ), Repsol SA, Siemens AG y Hunt Oil Co. Lindsayca Inc., contratista industrial con sede en Houston, y la catarí UCC Holding participan como socios estratégicos. También se espera la presencia de la ministra de Petróleo, Paula Henao, y del ministro de Relaciones Exteriores, Felix Plasencia. Delcy Rodríguez, presidenta interina de Venezuela respaldada por EE.UU., también podría dirigirse a los asistentes. Ese nivel de asistencia hizo aún más urgente la búsqueda de palos de golf. Entre los jugadores que necesitaban equipos había ejecutivos de Cotemar SA de CV, contratista mexicano de servicios petroleros costa afuera y patrocinador del torneo. Moulds y su equipo tuvieron suerte en Morsa’s Proshop, un negocio familiar. “Necesitaban todo de inmediato, algo difícil aquí, porque normalmente la gente se hace una prueba para elegir los palos y luego los encarga especialmente”, dijo María Fernanda Núñez, directora de Morsa’s, cuyo padre fundó el negocio después de hacerse conocido por reparar palos de golf como pasatiempo. “También fue difícil encontrar gente dispuesta a prestar palos”, dijo Núñez. “Muy pocos venezolanos juegan golf y este país ha pasado por mucho, así que hay falta de confianza”. Caracas tiene tres principales clubes privados de golf, pero ningún campo público ni resort que normalmente preste equipos. Por eso, incluso con los palos nuevos y prestados de Morsa’s, es probable que algunos participantes del torneo tengan que compartir palos, algo impensable para golfistas experimentados. “Si falta algo, intentaremos pedírselo prestado a los profesionales”, dijo Henrique Lavie, gerente de golf del Caracas Country Club. “Estamos haciendo todo lo posible para que todos lo pasen bien”. En los verdes fairways del señorial Caracas Country Club, la antigua gloria nunca desapareció del todo. Construido hace más de un siglo sobre antiguas plantaciones de café y con la asesoría del heredero estadounidense y exvicepresidente Nelson Rockefeller, el club es sinónimo del viejo dinero venezolano. Ante el exceso de asistentes a la conferencia, parte del público será trasladado a una sala adicional del hotel para seguir las conversaciones por transmisión en vivo. “Va a estar un poco apretado”, dijo Moulds. Las entradas, que costaban US$2.950 cada una antes de agotarse, reflejan un “FOMO enorme”, sigla en inglés que alude al temor de quedarse fuera o perderse algo, dijo un ejecutivo local que intentó sin éxito conseguirle un lugar en la conferencia a un amigo. Parte de lo recaudado será donado a las labores de reconstrucción tras los dos devastadores terremotos de Venezuela, dijo Moulds. No está claro si todo ese entusiasmo se traducirá en grandes inversiones en Venezuela, dada la enorme tarea de reconstruir la infraestructura petrolera básica y recuperar la confianza de los inversores. El país produce alrededor de 1,2 millones de barriles de crudo al día, frente a más de 3 millones en la década de 1990. Ver más: La apertura petrolera de Venezuela despierta expectativas entre proveedores que vuelven a mirar al país Aunque muchas compañías petroleras han firmado acuerdos preliminares con la estatal Petróleos de Venezuela SA, pocas han asumido compromisos firmes mientras persisten dudas sobre el cumplimiento de las sanciones de EE.UU., las responsabilidades ambientales y las condiciones políticas en Caracas y Washington. Por ahora, el entusiasmo está en el green. “Durante 10 o 15 años, Venezuela no estuvo acostumbrada a recibir a tanta gente del extranjero para jugar golf”, dijo Diego Alexandre, miembro de la comisión de golf del Caracas Country Club. “Las tiendas simplemente tendrán que abastecerse. Es un buen problema”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Adani Firms Settle Shareholding Norms Violation Case
item.description: Billionaire Gautam Adani’s group firms settled a probe over alleged non-compliance with minimum public shareholding requirements with markets regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
item.dc:creator: Shruti Srivastava and Samie Modak

item.title: Gautam Adani, four group firms, 13 others settle MPS case with Sebi
item.description: Gautam Adani, four Adani group firms and 13 others paid a cumulative ₹1.48 crore to settle proceedings over alleged non-compliance with minimum public shareholding norms.
item.dc:creator: Khushboo Tiwari
item.content:encoded: Four Adani group companies, its chairman Gautam Adani, and 13 others have settled proceedings with the market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) by paying a cumulative sum of ₹1.48 crore under the settlement regulations. This is the third settlement order this month by Sebi involving the coal-to-port conglomerate. The matter pertained to alleged non-compliance with the minimum public shareholding requirements for certain listed companies. The market regulator had issued a show-cause notice in the matter in September 2024—following examinations stemming from certain complaints during June and July 2020. Based on the preliminary examination, Sebi had initiated investigations in October 2020 involving Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone, and Adani Energy Solutions (earlier Adani Transmission). A supplementary show-cause notice was sent to the entities in March 2025, following which the companies filed settlement applications—without admitting or denying Sebi’s findings. Along with the group firms, the settlement order also disposes of proceedings against Adani Enterprises Managing Director Rajesh Adani and board member Pranav Adani, among others. Sebi’s internal committee had informed the companies about the revised terms of settlement in May this year, while the high-powered advisory committee agreed to the terms in June. With the settlement amount remitted in August 2026, the market regulator has disposed of the proceedings against the companies and the individuals. Last week, five companies of the Adani group settled adjudication proceedings with Sebi for ₹1.51 crore over an alleged lapse in the disclosure of related-party transactions. The case had originated from Sebi’s examination into allegations of undisclosed related-party transactions (RPTs) and corporate governance lapses flagged in a report by the now-defunct Hindenburg Research. Earlier this month, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) Managing Director Karan Adani and Chief Financial Officer B Ravi settled adjudication proceedings with the market regulator in a matter involving PMC Projects. Under the settlement mechanism, both paid ₹13.65 lakh each, following which the proceedings were disposed of. The settlement order on September 10 had stated that the investigations were in respect of the banking transactions and inter-corporate security deposits among PMC Projects (India), APSEZ and its subsidiaries. Last year in September, Sebi had closed proceedings against Adani group companies, group Chairman Gautam Adani, and associated entities facing accusations of fund diversion, violations of related-party transaction (RPT) norms, and fraud. In two separate orders, the regulator had exculpated the group in the matter of allegations made by short-seller Hindenburg Research in 2023, effectively bringing the curtains down on the saga that had triggered a ₹12 trillion market-cap rout at the business group.

item.title: Buttler ruled out of Pakistan Tri-series with hamstring injury
item.description: Jos Buttler will miss England's one-day international Tri-series in Pakistan next month after suffering a hamstring injury against Sri Lanka last week, limited-overs coach Brendon McCullum said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jos Buttler will miss England's one-day international Tri-series in Pakistan next month after suffering a hamstring injury against Sri Lanka last week, limited-overs coach Brendon McCullum said on Monday. The former England captain pulled up while batting during England's 16-run defeat at Headingley on Thursday. He initially retired hurt before returning to the crease later in the innings. The 36-year-old was replaced by Jordan Cox for Sunday's third ODI at The Oval, where Cox scored 76 in England's 223-run win. "Jos won't be in Pakistan," McCullum told reporters. "We know he's an incredible athlete, supremely fit and an ultra-professional, so he'll do everything he can to get back as soon as possible. But it's hard to judge how long that will be." England travel to Pakistan for a Tri-series involving the hosts and Sri Lanka beginning on October 18. The side will head to Australia in November for three ODIs and five Twenty20 internationals. McCullum said Buttler's absence offered an opportunity to test England's depth ahead of next year's 50-over World Cup. "It's disappointing not to have Jos, but it will be good for us to see where we're at," he said. "Between now and 14 months' time, lots of things will go wrong. There'll be selections you think will happen and then someone will get injured, or there'll be a scheduling issue. You almost have to catastrophise these things a little to prepare yourself for that World Cup." Next year's World Cup will be played in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia starting on October 4.

item.title: Poland lifts warning to take shelter following Russia strikes on Ukraine
item.description: Poland's Government Centre for Security on Monday lifted a warning it had issued minutes earlier that had told people in the eastern Lublin region to take shelter due to Russian air strikes on neighbouring Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland's Government Centre for Security on Monday lifted a warning it had issued minutes earlier that had told people in the eastern Lublin region to take shelter due to Russian air strikes on neighbouring Ukraine. "ATTENTION! The air attack threat has been lifted. There is no threat within the territory of Poland," the centre said. It had earlier said Polish jets were operating in Polish airspace as a result of Russian strikes on Ukraine.

item.title: Workers at Antofagasta's Centinela mine reject offer, pave way for strike
item.description: Workers from two unions at Antofagasta Minerals' Centinela copper mine in northern Chile rejected on Monday the company's collective contract offer, paving the way for a strike.
item.dc:creator: Fabian Cambero
item.content:encoded: Workers from two unions at Antofagasta Minerals' (ANTO.L) Centinela copper mine in northern Chile rejected on Monday the company's collective contract offer, paving the way for a strike. The company and unions must now undergo a mandatory five-day government-led mediation process, which can be extended for another five days by mutual agreement, before a strike can legally begin 98.73% of unions members voted in favor of a strike, with all eligible members participating in the vote The Minera Esperanza and Distrito Centinela unions had urged their members to reject the offer, complaining that Antofagasta Minerals has refused to discuss equalizing benefits for workers regardless of union affiliation Antofagasta Minerals does not comment on its collective bargaining negotiations Centinela produced 240,400 metric tons of copper in 2025
