item.title: Fed, watchdog interno segnala possibile fuga di informazioni da dipendente
item.description: L'organismo di controllo interno della Federal Reserve ha emesso un avviso in cui segnala un dipendente che potrebbe aver lasciato la banca centrale portando con sé informazioni riservate.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'organismo di controllo interno della Federal Reserve ha emesso un avviso in cui segnala un dipendente che potrebbe aver lasciato la banca centrale portando con sé informazioni riservate. "Questo avviso riguarda un dipendente del Board in uscita che potrebbe aver sottratto informazioni classificate del Federal Open Market Committee (Fomc) e altre informazioni sensibili", dopo essere stato coinvolto in precedenza in "un incidente di sicurezza informatica" relativo a informazioni del Fomc, ha affermato l'Ispettore generale della Fed. "Questo potenziale episodio mette in luce i rischi per la sicurezza delle informazioni, nonché carenze e falle nei controlli che, a nostro avviso, richiedono l’immediata attenzione del Board", ha sottolineato l’organismo di controllo.

item.title: Usa e Iran pronti a colloqui separati con mediatori oggi o domani - fonte
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 16.10 - I mediatori del Qatar dovrebbero tenere colloqui con il ministro degli Esteri iraniano Abbas Araqchi a New York e, separatamente, con la parte statunitense oggi o domani. Lo ha riferito a Reuters una fonte informata sui negoziati, nel quadro di un nuovo tentativo di porre fine alla guerra. 15.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri iraniano Abbas Araqchi incontrerà i mediatori oggi a New York Lo ha detto l'agenzia iraniana Isna. Secondo quanto riferito in precedenza da un funzionario informato sui negoziati, i colloqui con i mediatori del Qatar dovrebbero concentrarsi su una versione modificata della proposta di sette giorni presentata dall'Iran la scorsa settimana a margine dell'Assemblea generale delle Nazioni Unite. 13.00 - Teheran ha respinto le forze nemiche dalle acque al largo dell'Iran meridionale fino al Mar Arabico. Lo ha comunicato la Guida Suprema Mojtaba Khamenei sul proprio canale Telegram, avvertendo che l'Iran le costringerà presto a ritirarsi anche oltre il Mar Arabico. 8.45 - L'alta rappresentante dell'Unione europea per gli Affari esteri, Kaja Kallas, ha detto che la missione Aspides, avviata per proteggere le navi nel Mar Rosso, necessita di un maggior numero di unità navali per diventare pienamente operativa. Intervenendo all'arrivo alla riunione dei ministri della Difesa dell'Ue a Bruxelles, Kallas ha detto di aver esortato gli Stati membri a contribuire maggiormente alla missione, senza tuttavia avere ricevuto finora nuovi impegni concreti. 7.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri saudita, il principe Faisal bin Farhan, è arrivato a Washington per un incontro con il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio. Lo ha riferito l'agenzia di stampa ufficiale saudita, mentre si intensificano le ostilità tra Riyadh e gli Houthi yemeniti. Questo mese il principe ereditario saudita Mohammed bin Salman aveva chiesto agli Stati Uniti un sostegno militare contro gli Houthi, sostenuti dall'Iran, ma Washington aveva respinto l'ipotesi di condurre attacchi diretti, accettando tuttavia di fornire supporto in termini di intelligence e identificazione degli obiettivi, secondo quanto riferito da fonti a Reuters. 7.00 - L'Iran ha ribadito domenica che solo la diplomazia può risolvere il conflitto con gli Stati Uniti e Israele, dopo che il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha affermato di aver respinto una proposta iraniana volta a riaprire lo Stretto di Hormuz e a porre fine ai combattimenti.

item.title: Bridgepoint, Astorg consider £2 billion-plus Fenergo sale, sources say
item.description: Bridgepoint and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion).
item.dc:creator: Amy-Jo Crowley
item.content:encoded: Bridgepoint (BPTB.L) and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion). The private equity firms have held discussions with potential buyers and are expected to appoint an investment bank later this year in a potential transaction that could attract strategic bidders, the sources told Reuters. A sales process could be launched early in 2027, with a decision yet to be taken, said two of the sources. Bridgepoint and Astorg both declined to comment. Dublin-based Fenergo did not respond to a request for comment. Fenergo develops software that helps more than 300 of the world's largest banks and insurers comply with regulatory requirements and manage client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, know-your-customer checks and data management. The potential deal highlights [USN:L6N45F0TW TEXT:"a pickup"] in tech dealmaking despite a selloff in software stocks earlier this year. [USN:L6N44U168 TEXT:"Thoma Bravo"] is exploring a sale of Foundation Software, Vista Equity Partners is considering selling banking software provider Finastra and healthcare software company Waystar is weighing its options, Reuters reported earlier this month. Fenergo, founded and led by CEO Mark Murphy, is expected to attract interest from information services companies and exchange operators, the sources said. Astorg and Bridgepoint acquired Fenergo from Insight Partners in 2021 for an undisclosed sum. The company has also sought to capitalise on demand for AI tools, launching an agentic AI orchestration platform designed to automate workflows such as onboarding and periodic reviews. Its total revenue rose by 7.5% to €149.4 million ($170 million) for the year ending in March 2025, driven by more subscription revenue and client renewals for its software products. Operating profit increased 66% to €20.9 million. ($1 = 0.7539 pounds) ($1 = 0.8799 euros)

item.title: Insider: Evonik zeigt BASF die kalte Schulter - Offerte zu niedrig
item.description: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik hat Insidern zufolge ein Übernahmeangebot des größeren Rivalen BASF abgewiesen. Die Offerte sei als zu niedrig angesehen worden, sagten zwei mit dem Vorgang vertraute Personen am Montag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. BASF habe rund 22,15 Euro je Evonik-Aktie geboten. Das Angebot entspricht einem Aufschlag von gut 28 Prozent auf den Evonik-Aktienkurs vor dem Bekanntwerden erster Übernahmespekulationen in der vergangenen Woche. Das Essener Unternehmen wird damit inklusive Schulden mit rund 14 Milliarden Euro bewertet. Evonik lehnte eine Stellungnahme ab.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik (EVKn.DE) hat Insidern zufolge ein Übernahmeangebot des größeren Rivalen BASF (BASFn.DE) abgewiesen. Die Offerte sei als zu niedrig angesehen worden, sagten zwei mit dem Vorgang vertraute Personen am Montag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. BASF habe rund 22,15 Euro je Evonik-Aktie geboten. Das Angebot entspricht einem Aufschlag von gut 28 Prozent auf den Evonik-Aktienkurs vor dem Bekanntwerden erster Übernahmespekulationen in der vergangenen Woche. Das Essener Unternehmen wird damit inklusive Schulden mit rund 14 Milliarden Euro bewertet. Evonik lehnte eine Stellungnahme ab. BASF wollte sich zu dem genannten Preis nicht äußern. Der Konzern teilte jedoch mit, eine mögliche Übernahme würde die eigenen Kerngeschäfte stärken und ergänzen. Dabei verfolge das Unternehmen einen disziplinierten Ansatz: "Unsere Bewertung basiert auf einem Synergiepotenzial, das nur unter Einbindung von Evonik verifiziert werden kann." Evonik-Aktien stiegen am Montag um bis zu 2,5 Prozent auf 19,85 Euro. Beide Unternehmen hatten [USN:L8N45H10Q TEXT:"am Freitag"] Sondierungsgespräche bestätigt. Für BASF wäre eine Übernahme von Evonik einer der größten Zukäufe in der gut 160-jährigen Firmengeschichte. Die bislang größten Übernahmen der Ludwigshafener waren der Erwerb der Saatgut- und Herbizidgeschäfte von Bayer (BAYGn.DE) im Jahr 2018 für 7,6 Milliarden Euro sowie der Kauf des US-Katalysatorherstellers Engelhard 2006 für 4,8 Milliarden Dollar. Eine Schlüsselrolle bei einem möglichen Zusammenschluss fällt der RAG-Stiftung zu, die 43 Prozent an Evonik hält. Im Kuratorium der Stiftung ist das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen durch Ministerpräsident Hendrik Wüst vertreten. Das Düsseldorfer Wirtschaftsministerium verfolge das Übernahmeinteresse sehr aufmerksam, erklärte Wirtschaftsministerin Mona Neubaur am Montag. "Jede Lösung muss sich daran messen lassen, ob sie den Investitionen an den Standorten in Nordrhein-Westfalen und den Menschen, die dort arbeiten, eine Zukunft gäbe", sagte sie. Die Stiftung selbst wollte sich zu der Offerte nicht äußern. Der Vorsitzende der Gewerkschaft IG BCE, Michael Vassiliadis, der sowohl im Kuratorium der RAG-Stiftung als auch im Aufsichtsrat von BASF sitzt, sieht bei einer möglichen Übernahme viele offene Fragen. Ein Kauf eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens durch ein anderes werde für Standorte und Beschäftigte nicht allein dadurch zu einer Zukunftsgeschichte, dass das neue Gebilde größer werde, [USN:L8N45K0ZF TEXT:"sagte er"] am Montag. Für die Beschäftigten beider Konzerne müsse es Zukunftsperspektiven und Investitionszusagen geben.

item.title: ECB eyes new currency safety nets to boost euro's global role
item.description: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing. The [USN:L4N3ZA02V TEXT:"push"] comes amid concerns over financial fragmentation and [USN:L4N44P02A TEXT:"growing uncertainty"] around the future of the US dollar under President Donald Trump. Lagarde said the ECB would work on swap lines, which act as a source of emergency liquidity at times of crisis by allowing foreign central banks to borrow euros in exchange for their own currency. "We will be working on swap lines that will be more responsive to the imperative of having a sovereign euro area and a strong euro," Lagarde told European lawmakers. Swap lines relieve pressure on foreign borrowers but also prevent stress abroad from spilling over into the euro area. The ECB has such arrangements with the US Federal Reserve and the central banks of Japan, Britain, Canada and Switzerland. The move is part of an ongoing ECB effort to expand the euro's international footprint. The ECB [USN:L8N41L3LR TEXT:"has received"] nearly 30 applications for a separate lending facility - known as repurchase agreements or repo - that allows foreign banks to borrow against euro collateral. Central bank officials and investors worry that the US Federal Reserve might eventually cut its own [USN:L8N41Y0WB TEXT:"swap lines"], which currently serve as the main global lifeline for trillions of dollars in foreign loans.

item.title: Russland stellt Metros Vermögenswerte unter Zwangsverwaltung
item.description: Der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin hat die Vermögenswerte des deutschen Handelskonzerns Metro unter vorübergehende staatliche Verwaltung gestellt. Dies geht aus einem am Montag veröffentlichten Präsidialdekret hervor. "Der russische Staat hat die operative Kontrolle an UK Torg RUS übertragen, ein Unternehmen des CEO von METRO Russia, Johannes Tholey", teilte Metro mit. Die Entscheidung fällt in eine Phase verschärfter Spannungen zwischen Moskau und Berlin wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der russische Präsident Wladimir Putin hat die Vermögenswerte des deutschen Handelskonzerns Metro (B4B0n.H) unter vorübergehende staatliche Verwaltung gestellt. Dies geht aus einem am Montag veröffentlichten Präsidialdekret hervor. "Der russische Staat hat die operative Kontrolle an UK Torg RUS übertragen, ein Unternehmen des CEO von METRO Russia, Johannes Tholey", teilte Metro mit. Die Entscheidung fällt in eine Phase verschärfter Spannungen zwischen Moskau und Berlin wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs. Das Dekret nannte keine Gründe für den Schritt. Der seit 2001 in Russland engagierte Handelskonzern war anders als zahlreiche andere westliche Unternehmen nach dem russischen Überfall auf die Ukraine im Land geblieben. Metro tue dies aus Rücksicht auf Mitarbeiter und Kunden, hatte der Konzern immer wieder erklärt. Metro beschäftigt in Russland rund 9000 Menschen und betreibt 91 Märkte. Metro hatte dort in der Vergangenheit Milliardenumsätze eingefahren. Der russische Außenminister Sergej Lawrow und sein deutscher Amtskollege Johann Wadephul hatten sich am Wochenende am Rande der UN-Vollversammlung in New York zu Gesprächen über die Ukraine getroffen. Lawrow erklärte anschließend, er habe dabei keine neuen Erkenntnisse gewonnen. Deutschland wirft Russland einen versuchten Drohnenangriff auf den Flughafen Leipzig/Halle vor und hatte als Reaktion unter anderem die Schließung eines russischen Konsulats und eines Kulturzentrums in Berlin angeordnet. Moskau bestreitet die Vorwürfe. Die russische Metro-Tochter teilte am Montag mit, der Betrieb laufe normal weiter und alle Verpflichtungen gegenüber Kunden würden erfüllt. Russland hatte erst Anfang September die Kontrolle über die russischen Vermögenswerte des Schweizer Nahrungsmittelkonzerns Nestle (NESN.S) und des französischen Einzelhändlers Auchan übernommen. Zur Begründung hieß es von russischer Seite, feindselige Handlungen "unfreundlicher" Staaten hätten bei dieser Entscheidung eine Rolle gespielt.

item.title: Trabajadores de mina chilena Centinela de Antofagasta rechazan contrato; abren vía a huelga
item.description: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela, de Antofagasta Minerals, rechazaron el lunes una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que allana el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento.
item.dc:creator: Fabián Andrés Cambero
item.content:encoded: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela, de Antofagasta Minerals, rechazaron el lunes una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que allana el camino a una huelga en el yacimiento. Según la legislación chilena, al rechazarse la oferta las partes aún deben pasar por una intermediación gubernamental obligatoria de cinco días, que puede extenderse por igual período de mutuo acuerdo, antes de quedar autorizado el inicio de una huelga. La semana pasada, los sindicatos de Minera Esperanza y de Distrito Centinela -que unieron su negociación colectiva- recibieron la última propuesta del proceso formal de diálogo y llamaron a rechazarla. "Respondiendo el llamado de la dirigencia sindical, el 98,73% del total de socios votó por la huelga, habiendo participado en la votación el 100% de los socios habilitados", dijo el gremio en un comunicado. Las organizaciones se han quejado que la empresa no ha querido discutir sobre la igualdad en los beneficios de los trabajadores, independiente del sindicato al que pertenezcan. "La empresa se ha negado hasta el momento a abordar una solución sobre la materia, que garantice el derecho de igualdad de trato. En virtud de esta negativa, los sindicatos han preparado sus planes de contingencia de huelga, para sostenerla todo el tiempo que sea necesario", agregaron. Antofagasta Minerals declina comentar sobre sus negociaciones colectivas.

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI will not attend Australian senate AI hearing on October 1
item.description: Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized access to the country's health system database.
item.dc:creator: Anzar Mehraj
item.content:encoded: Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized[USN:L4N45F1EW TEXT:" access"] to the country's health system database. The Claude-parent has sought another date, the person who declined to be named, said as the invitation came late last week. OpenAI too cited the same reason and said it could not arrange for its executives to appear in the short time frame. The senate inquiry is examining the potential impacts of AI and data centers on Australian communities, industries, water and energy. It is one of several state and federal probes into AI. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were sent [USN:L4N45J005 TEXT:"written requests to appear"] before the senate inquiry in Canberra, after the Medicare hack. The disclosure could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called the incident "unacceptable" and said he had raised "extreme concern" with Altman. OpenAI said it was following the committee's work and would remain in contact if further hearings were scheduled. Meanwhile, OpenAI's Chief Strategy Officer Jason Kwon will travel from the US to appear before a separate Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence in Sydney on October 6, an OpenAI spokesperson said, adding that the company had lodged a submission to that inquiry.

Egypt boss Hassan seeks to ease Salah tensions ahead of South Sudan qualifier

FAST

Sept 28 : Egypt coach Hossam Hassan sought on Monday to calm speculation over Mohamed Salah's relationship with the national team after his omission from Tuesday's Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against South Sudan fuelled debate in local media. The issue has dominated discussions around the Egypt camp since the seven-times African champions were held to a 0-0 draw by Angola in their Group B opener, when Salah was substituted midway through the second half before leaving camp the next day. Speculation intensified after Hassan said the substitution was made for "technical reasons", despite Salah's strong form since joining Turkish side Trabzonspor from Liverpool. Local reports also linked the controversy to some of Hassan's previous comments about senior players, including goalkeeper Mohamed El Shenawy who he said "at one point was finished", prompting questions about the mood inside the squad.

However, Hassan struck a conciliatory tone ahead of the trip to Juba, underlining Salah's importance to Egypt's plans. "I respect all the players, especially Mohamed Salah. He is an important and influential player, one of the team's key pillars, a great player and a vital member of the team, as well as one of the best players in the world," he told reporters. The coach said 34-year-old Salah's absence against South Sudan had been agreed between them before the Angola match because of concerns over the artificial playing surface. "We decided to rest Salah because of the artificial pitch. He had discussed the matter with me before the Angola match, and we agreed on it," Hassan said. "We need Salah in the upcoming matches. The well-being of every player is my top priority, and I have great confidence in all the players," he added. Egypt are seeking their first victory of the qualifying campaign as they bid to reach the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations finals in Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.

(Reporting Ashraf Hamed Atta; Editing by Ken Ferris)

item.title: With Burry as adviser, a new short-focused fund takes aim at private credit risks - Reuters
item.description: With Burry as adviser, a new short-focused fund takes aim at private credit risks Reuters

item.title: With Burry as adviser, a new short-focused fund takes aim at private credit risks
item.description: Wall Street is busy scouring AI stocks for signs of a bubble, but a new hedge fund tied to famed short seller Michael Burry is coming to the market eyeing more consequential warnings of rising froth elsewhere - in private credit loan books.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Wall Street is busy scouring AI stocks for signs of a bubble, but a new hedge fund tied to famed short seller Michael Burry is coming to the market eyeing more consequential warnings of rising froth elsewhere - in private credit loan books. Minerva Investment Management, a short-biased fund by Laks Ganapathi which has hired Burry [USN:L4N4580LJ TEXT:"as a senior adviser"], is scanning sectors spanning healthcare, retail, restaurants and smaller banks for short targets. Financing of many companies in these sectors are tied to private credit and they could be quietly rotting beneath the surface, Ganapathi said in an interview with Reuters. Short-biased funds structured as hedge funds mainly profit when stock prices decline. Ganapathi declined to name specific short targets and the size of the fund, which she said will be launched later this month. "AI is not the entire market, even though it appears to be," Ganapathi said. "For us, credit is the leading indicator and signal on how the market is going to be." The fund is targeting a potential blind spot as private credit's opacity can mask financial strain on borrowers for years, as highlighted in the bankruptcies of US auto parts supplier First Brands, car dealer Tricolor and UK mortgage provider Market Financial Solutions. "This time around, it is not going to be like 2008. It's going to be a lot worse," Ganapathi said. US private credit default rate reached an all-time high of 6.3% in August on an annualized basis, according to Fitch Ratings. TOUGH TERRAIN Minerva is entering an unforgiving corner of the hedge fund industry. Dedicated short-biased funds have dwindled to just six as of the second quarter of 2026 from 54 in 2008, according to HFR industry estimates. Much of it has been due to the increased regulatory scrutiny of short positions, a challenging performance environment for short exposures and changes in hedge fund reporting in the US. The 2021 [USN:L8N2K32JL TEXT:"Gamestop GME.N frenzy"] underscored the risks of crowded short bets as a stock's move disconnected from fundamentals can quickly overwhelm a sound investment case. Still, Ganapathi said Minerva could benefit from Burry's experience. His bets against the subprime mortgage market in 2008 were chronicled in "The Big Short". Burry wound down his hedge fund, Scion Asset Management, late last year, and launched a paid Substack newsletter, "Cassandra Unchained", which he uses to publish his market views. Ganapathi said someone close to Burry had first introduced them. She later reached out to Burry after he subscribed to her Substack newsletter, eventually asking him to join Minerva. Ganapathi is also the founder of Unicus Research, a short-selling research firm. Some of its top bearish recommendations were on electric vehicle maker Faraday Futures (FFAI.O) and used-car retailer Carvana (CVNA.N) , according to its website.

item.title: Despite geopolitical risks, Street remains bullish on Petronet LNG outlook
item.description: Analysts remain positive on Petronet LNG, citing Kochi growth, new revenue streams and project execution despite high spot LNG prices and geopolitical risks ahead.
item.dc:creator: Devangshu Datta
item.content:encoded: Many analysts who went to Petronet LNG’s Kochi terminal for a management meet are positive on the prospects of India’s largest liquefied natural gas (LNG) infrastructure company. This is a contrarian take given the current geopolitics. Gas supply has been affected by the US-Israel-Iran war and the stock has seen substantial correction. The management of Petronet, which is 50 per cent owned by public sector oil and gas companies (12.5 per cent each by Bharat Petroleum or BPCL, Gail, Indian Oil, and ONGC) is positive about quick resumption of Qatar supply following resolution of the Iran conflict, whenever that might happen.

item.title: スペースＸの「スターシップ」、初の軌道到達 衛星26基展開
item.description:
Joey Roulette
[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joey Roulette

[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ の次世代ロケット「スターシップ」が２８日、米テキサス州から打ち上げられ、同社の打ち上げとして初めて地球の周回軌道に到達した。

飛行中にエンジン１基が予定より早く停止するトラブルが発生したものの、軌道に乗ることに成功。軌道到達後は、計画された高度約２６９キロ付近で衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の次世代衛星２６基の展開を開始した。

スターシップはこれまでで最長となる約１０時間の飛行で地球を６周した後、南米チリ沖に着水する見通し。地球帰還を成功させられるかが今回の主要目標の一つとなる。

打ち上げに使用された第１段ブースター「スーパーヘビー」はメキシコ湾に帰還し、エンジン制御による着水を行った。

今回の飛行試験は１４回目。スペースＸが２０２３年以降に実施したこれまでの１３回の打ち上げはいずれも軌道到達に至らなかった。マスク氏は早ければ今年後半にも、スターシップの定期的な運用を開始したい考えを示している。

item.title: FBI deputy chief Bailey to resign after just over a year with agency
item.description: FBI Co-Deputy Director Andrew Bailey said on Monday he is resigning his position, leaving the most prominent US law enforcement agency after a little more than a year.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: FBI Co-Deputy Director Andrew Bailey said on Monday he is resigning his position, leaving the most prominent US law enforcement agency after a little more than a year. Bailey, a Republican ally of President Donald Trump who [USN:L1N3UA0W1 TEXT:"left his job"] as Missouri attorney general to join the FBI, said he was leaving to return to his family. Bailey, serving under FBI Director Kash Patel, helped oversee election-related investigations and was present earlier this year when agents [USN:L1N3Z00SF TEXT:"seized"] 2020 election ballots from Georgia. "I am confident Director Patel will continue to reform the FBI, combat violent crime, defend the homeland, ensure strong organizational accountability, and restore public trust in this institution of excellence," Bailey wrote on social media. The deputy director's post, which oversees day-to-day law enforcement operations, has traditionally been apolitical and filled by career FBI officials. Trump has installed political allies in the role as he overhauls the agency to align with his agenda. Bailey initially served as co-deputy director alongside Dan Bongino, a former US Secret Service agent and conservative podcaster, who [USN:L6N3XN1EP TEXT:"left the FBI"] in January. Christopher Raia, a veteran FBI official, has more recently served as part of a three-person leadership team with Bailey and Patel. Bailey joined the FBI following a series of high-profile stumbles by Patel, including botched handling of investigative files on late sex offender and financier Jeffrey Epstein that caused [USN:L1N3TL13Z TEXT:"political headaches"] for the Trump administration and internal tension at the Justice Department. The latest high-profile departure at the FBI occurred about five weeks before the US midterm elections that will determine control of Congress. The Trump administration has [USN:L6N45F10R TEXT:"mobilized"] federal law enforcement agencies to investigate voting in elections by non-US citizens. Bailey during his tenure at the FBI has helped manage the Trump administration's investigations into election issues. The FBI has scrutinized election records from several states, but has not produced evidence to substantiate Trump's false claims that widespread voter fraud led to his electoral defeat in 2020.

item.title: 米30年債利回り04年以来の高水準、トランプ氏のイラン和平案拒否で原油高
item.description:
Sinéad Carew
[２８日 ロイター] - ２８日の米国債利回りは上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時、２００４年５月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米30年債利回り04年以来の高水準、トランプ氏のイラン和平案拒否で原油高 9/28 23:49 配信

写真はドル紙幣。2023年3月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Sinéad Carew

[２８日　ロイター] - ２８日の米国債利回りは上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時、２００４年５月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。トランプ米大統領がイランの和平案を拒否したことを受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレ長期化と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げへの警戒感が高まった。

１０年債利回りも一時、０７年６月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。３０年債利回り、１０年債利回りとも、その後上昇幅を縮小した。

トランプ氏が２６日、ホルムズ海峡を再開し中東での戦闘を終結させるとするイランの提案を拒否したと表明したことを背景に、米原油先物は約２％上昇。 これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込むＦＲＢが１０月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の追加利上げを実施する確率は６８％と、２５日の６４％から上昇。１２月の追加利上げ観測も強まった。

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフ債券ストラテジスト、ローレンス・ギラム氏は「トランプ氏が中東停戦案を拒否したことで原油価格が再び上昇している。イランを巡る紛争の不確実性が残る限り、債券利回りには上昇圧力がかかり続ける公算が大きい」と指摘。「原油高は今後のインフレ指標に波及する。市場は今後１２カ月にわたるＦＲＢの利上げサイクルを織り込んでいる」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 最終更新: 9/28(月) 23:49 ロイター

item.title: Lagarde del BCE se apega a estrategia de medidas graduales para frenar inflación
item.description: El repunte de la inflación de este año aún no ha generado efectos secundarios peligrosos en toda la zona del euro, por lo que sigue siendo adecuada una respuesta moderada por parte del Banco Central Europeo, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El repunte de la inflación de este año aún no ha generado efectos secundarios peligrosos en toda la zona del euro, por lo que sigue siendo adecuada una respuesta moderada por parte del Banco Central Europeo, dijo el lunes la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde. La inflación de la zona del euro ya ha superado el 3% y podría acercarse al 4% a finales de año, el doble del objetivo del banco, lo que alimenta las apuestas del mercado a que serán necesarias hasta cuatro subidas de tasas más el próximo año, además de las dos ya aplicadas durante el verano boreal. Lagarde, sin embargo, pareció rebatir algunas de las previsiones más agresivas del mercado, argumentando que el alza de los precios del petróleo y el gas, derivada del conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán, es el principal factor que impulsa la subida de los precios. "Prevemos una mayor inflación en el futuro, pero aún no hay indicios de que se esté consolidando", dijo ante una comisión del Parlamento Europeo en Bruselas. "En este momento no vemos indicios de que los precios de la energía estén provocando un incremento de los salarios". "Esto significa que, aunque el impacto es demasiado grande como para ignorarlo, consideramos que una respuesta mesurada es la adecuada para mantener la inflación bajo control", añadió. Lagarde reconoció que los riesgos se inclinaban hacia una mayor inflación y que también existe el riesgo de que los gobiernos ofrecieran generosas ayudas para proteger a los consumidores frente al aumento de los costos energéticos. El apoyo fiscal se ha incrementado hasta situarse en torno a 0,1 puntos porcentuales del PIB de la zona del euro y las medidas han sido mucho menos temporales o específicas de lo que se esperaba, señaló Lagarde. El efecto conjunto de estas medidas tendrá un impacto de aproximadamente el 0,1% en la inflación, añadió. El problema es que, si bien los subsidios ayudan a reducir la inflación a corto plazo, a menudo la prolongan durante un período más largo y hacen aumentar el gasto fiscal, lo que provoca problemas más duraderos. Aunque Lagarde no detalló a qué se refería con una "respuesta mesurada", los economistas señalan que las dos primeras subidas de tasas, con tres meses de diferencia entre ellas, son una buena referencia. Por ello, muchos economistas prevén que el BCE mantenga las tasas estables en su reunión del 29 de octubre y las suba solo en diciembre, cuando se publiquen las nuevas previsiones. Estas opiniones se vieron reforzadas el lunes, cuando Lagarde reiteró su mensaje anterior de que las tasas de interés no evolucionarán al mismo ritmo que los costos energéticos. En cuanto a la economía, Lagarde se mostró optimista, argumentando que el sector manufacturero está registrando un comportamiento sólido, el mercado laboral se mantiene robusto y la inversión también debería respaldar el crecimiento.

Sep 28 (Field Level Media) - Cheryl Reeve of the Minnesota Lynx was named WNBA Coach of the Year for a record-extending fifth time on Monday. Reeve received 40 of 74 votes from a national panel of sportswriters and broadcasters after leading the Lynx to a league-best 33-11 record in the regular season. She previously won the award in 2011, 2016, 2020 and 2024. No one else has won the award more than three times since it was first handed out in 1997. Natalie Nakase of the Golden State Valkyries finished second with 20 votes and Sydney Johnson of the Washington Mystics was third with 14 votes. Reeve, 60, is 397-201 in 17 seasons as the head coach in Minnesota. She became the league's all-time leader in regular-season wins with her 380th victory on July 8 against the Connecticut Sun. Her top-seeded Lynx, pursuing their record fifth WNBA championship, trail 1-0 in their best-of-three, first-round playoff series against the New York Liberty. Game 2 is on Tuesday night in New York. (-Field Level Media)

item.title: Activos argentinos redoblan debilidad en inicio de semana por temor a recesión
item.description: Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaban su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaban su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión. El Gobierno reportó la semana pasada una fuerte caída en el [USN:ZON00GJPU TEXT:"consumo"] y un aumento en los niveles de [USN:S0N44F01B TEXT:"pobreza"], lo que alienta fantasmas de recesión a un año de las elecciones presidenciales. A esto se suma la suba gradual del dólar y la perspectiva de otra alza en las tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed), lo que conspira contra la liquidez de los mercados emergentes. El nivel del riesgo país se movía en los 641 puntos básicos (1600 GMT), un máximo en 10 meses, y el peso mayorista se depreciaba un 0,29 a 1.520 por dólar , tras anotar su piso récord intradiario en 1.535 unidades. "En la economía se confirma el clima recesivo: nuevos indicadores ilustran sobre la coyuntura con una caída en el consumo (...) y una medición de la pobreza alcista que confirmó las sensaciones negativas", sintetizó VatNet Financial Research. La bolsa de Buenos Aires cedía un 2,1% en el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) y arrastraba su sexta baja consecutiva, con un acumulado en torno al 8,5% con la salida de fondos de inversión. Este contexto impactaba sobre los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles con un pérdida del 0,2% en promedio, contra un derrumbe del 3,1% durante la semana previa. "La suba reciente del riesgo país y la presión observada sobre la curva de deuda soberana responden a una interacción de factores donde el frente internacional actúa como el principal disparador, combinándose en el plano doméstico con datos de actividad económica más débiles y un menor ritmo de compras netas de reservas", dijo Eric Ritondale, economista jefe de Puente. El gigante estadounidense J.P. Morgan redujo recientemente a 1,5% su proyección de crecimiento económico para Argentina este año, cuando la gestión del libertario Javier Milei proyectó un avance del 3%. El propio Milei descartó la proyección de una recesión durante una entrevista televisiva el domingo por la noche, aduciendo que hay datos estadísticos incorrectos. Mientras tanto, el Tesoro desarrollará durante el lunes una licitación de deuda en la que enfrenta vencimientos por unos 8,1 billones de pesos (unos 5.300 millones de dólares). El menú ofertado consiste en una letra "Lecap" corta (S13N6), una "Lecer" (X29E7), dos "Bontam" (TMF27 y TML27) y cuatro "dollar linked" (D30O6, D30N6, D31M7 y TZV27). Como sucedió en las dos licitaciones de agosto, el Tesoro no pone a disposición papeles con vencimiento en el próximo mandato presidencial, desde diciembre del 2027 en adelante.

item.title: India regulator allows Adani, four group firms to settle public-float violations case
item.description: India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said four Adani companies and 14 company directors, including Gautam Adani, had settled the proceedings by paying a total of 14.82 million rupees ($154,403.15). In a separate order, the regulator said it has disposed of its case against the group claiming certain promoter holdings were categorised as public holdings. SEBI said it could not establish that investments made through two offshore funds and another public shareholder were directed by Vinod Adani, brother of Gautam Adani. Adani Group did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. In 2020, SEBI had received complaints against the group's flagship company Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited and Adani Transmission — now known as Adani Energy Solutions — claiming they were not in compliance with its minimum public float rules. In its notices to the companies and Adani, the regulator had alleged violations of the public shareholding requirements and related shareholding disclosure rules. However, the settlement order does not require the companies to make any corrective shareholding disclosures, nor does it contain a regulatory finding on the alleged violations. The probe was part of the 24 investigations SEBI had undertaken after US-based short-seller Hindenburg alleged in 2023 that Adani group companies manipulated their stock prices through tax havens. Adani Group had denied the allegations. SEBI has since allowed the group [USN:L4N45E0QA TEXT:"to settle several"] cases in the last year, although probes are still pending into whether certain Adani Group offshore investors circumvented Indian rules and whether there was manipulation in the trading of the group's shares. The case disposed of on Monday centred on SEBI's investigations into whether offshore funds whose investments in Adani Group firms were funded largely through entities linked to two individuals — Nasser Ali Shaban Ahli and Chang Chung-Ling — were acting under the direction or control of Vinod Adani. The regulator's final order concluded there was insufficient evidence that Vinod Adani controlled investment decisions of the funds, including Emerging India Focus Funds and EM Resurgent Fund. However, SEBI fined Ahli and Ling 2 million rupees each for failing to furnish correct and complete information during the investigation. ($1 = 95.9825 Indian rupees)

item.title: Russia puts German retailer Metro's assets under temporary administration amid Ukraine tensions
item.description: Russia has placed the local assets of German retailer Metro AG under temporary administration, according to a presidential decree published on Monday, amid heightened Ukraine-linked tensions between Moscow and Berlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia has placed the local assets of German retailer Metro AG under temporary administration, according to a presidential decree published on Monday, amid heightened Ukraine-linked tensions between Moscow and Berlin. The assets have been transferred to Russian company UK Torg RUS, which was established on September 8 and is wholly owned, according to Russian corporate data, by Johannes Tolay, the chief executive of Metro's Russian business. The decree did not give a reason for the transfer of control, but it followed [USN:L1N45I04M TEXT:"a rare weekend meeting"] between Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and German counterpart Johann Wadephul on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York to discuss Ukraine. Lavrov complained that he had learned nothing new from Wadephul, whose country is a staunch supporter of Ukraine. Germany this month said it had concluded that [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Russia was responsible for an attempted drone attack"] at Leipzig/Halle Airport and ordered a series of measures in response, including closure of a consulate and a Russian cultural centre in Berlin. Moscow denied the allegations, saying they had been fabricated. In a statement on Monday, Metro AG said it no longer had operational control over its Russian subsidiary and that it was evaluating further implications of the move. Metro expanded into the Russian market in 2001. Today it operates 91 wholesale stores and employs 9,000 people in Russia, the company says. Unlike many other Western companies, it remained in Russia after Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, a decision it said was based on its responsibility to employees and customers. In a separate statement, Metro's Russian subsidiary did not comment directly on the decree but said it was operating as normal and fulfilling all obligations to shoppers at its retail outlets and online stores. The Kremlin this month [USN:L8N45A06P TEXT:"transferred control"] of the Russian assets of Swiss food giant Nestle (NESN.S) and French retailer Auchan, saying that hostile actions by "unfriendly" countries played a role in that decision.

item.title: メタ、法人向けのAI事業に参入－責任者にモンゴDBのCEOを起用
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米メタ・プラットフォームズは、法人顧客向けの新たなAIプラットフォームを率いる責任者に、データベースソフトウエアを手掛けるモンゴDBの社長兼最高経営責任者（CEO）を起用した。マーク・ザッカーバーグCEOは同事業を「次の主要な柱」と位置付けている。

チランタン・CJ・デサイ氏がチーフ・エンタープライズ・プラットフォーム・オフィサーに就任し、法人向けの新たなAIサービスを統括すると、ザッカーバーグ氏が28日、X（旧ツイッター）への投稿で明らかにした。

新事業「メタ・エンタープライズ・プラットフォーム」は、企業がAIを活用して成長し、新たな形で変革を遂げるのを支援する。ザッカーバーグ氏は、高度なモデルやAIエージェント、AIインフラに加え、「多くの企業と長年緊密に協力してきた経験」など、メタの強みを生かすと説明した。

モンゴDB株はニューヨーク市場の取引開始後、一時27%安の300.45ドルまで急落した。マイクロソフトやセールスフォース、サービスナウなど企業向けソフトウエア株も下落。メタ株も売られている。

モンゴDBは28日、取締役会がデブ・イティチェリア氏を暫定社長兼CEOに復帰させたと発表した。同氏は2014年から2025年まで両職を務めていた。取締役会は、デサイ氏の正式な後任選びに着手した。

原題：Meta Taps MongoDB CEO to Lead New Enterprise AI Platform (1)（抜粋）

item.description: ＥＣＢの緩やかな利上げ継続適切、インフレの二次的効果見られず＝総裁 Reuters

item.title: ＥＣＢの緩やかな利上げ継続適切、インフレの二次的効果見られず＝総裁
item.description: [フランクフルト ２８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は２８日、今年のインフレはユーロ圏全体に危...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢの緩やかな利上げ継続適切、インフレの二次的効果見られず＝総裁 9/28 23:29 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁。独ベルリンで１０日撮影。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

[フランクフルト　２８日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は２８日、今年のインフレはユーロ圏全体に危険な二次的効果をまだ生み出していないため、ＥＣＢとして緩やかな政策対応が引き続き適切だとの認識を示した。欧州議会の委員会公聴会で述べた。

ユーロ圏のインフレ率はすでに３％を超えており、年末までにＥＣＢの目標の倍となる４％に近づく可能性がある。市場では、夏場に実施された２回の利上げに加え、来年にかけて最大４回の追加利上げが必要になるとの見方が広がっている。

ただ、ラガルド氏は市場の一部の積極的な利上げ観測をけん制する姿勢を示し、米・イラン紛争に起因する原油・ガス価格の高騰が物価上昇の主な要因であると指摘。

その上で「今後、インフレ率の上昇が見込まれるが、それが定着しつつある兆候はまだ見られない」とし、「現段階では、エネルギー価格が賃金上昇に波及している証拠は見当たらない」と述べた。

さらに「今回のショックは一時的なものとして受け止めるには大きすぎる一方、われわれはインフレを抑制するには慎重な対応が適切であると見ている」と言及。一方で、インフレ指標は上振れリスクに傾いており、見通しを巡る不確実性は極めて高いことを認めた。

「慎重な対応」の定義は明確ではないものの、エコノミストによると、３カ月間隔で実施された最初の２回の利上げが目安になるという。

ラガルド氏は、経済動向については楽観的な見方を維持。製造業は堅調に推移し、労働市場も底堅く、投資も成長を支えるはずだと述べた。

そのほかラガルド氏は、エネルギー高騰を相殺するためのユーロ圏各国政府による財政支援は拡大しており、政策当局者が期待していたほど一時的でも的を絞ったものでもないと指摘。「ユーロ圏全体で見ると、支援規模はユーロ圏域内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比０．１％ポイント程度に達している」とし、「これは３カ月前に測定された０．０３％ポイントから増加しており、必ずしも一時的でも、的を絞ったものでもない」と述べた。

ラガルド氏はさらに、海外の中央銀行がユーロを借り入れやすくするため、通貨のセーフティーネットを拡大する方針を表明。具体策として、危機時に海外中銀が自国通貨と引き換えにユーロを借り入れることを可能にする「スワップライン（通貨スワップ）」の拡充に取り組むとし、「主権あるユーロ圏と強いユーロを確保するという喫緊の課題により機敏に応えられるようなスワップラインの拡充を進めていく」と述べた。

スワップラインは海外の借り手の資金調達圧力を和らげると同時に、海外でのストレスがユーロ圏に波及するのを防ぐ役割も果たす。ＥＣＢは現在、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）や日銀、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）、カナダ銀行（中央銀行）、スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）との間でこうした取り決めを結んでいる。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 最終更新: 9/29(火) 0:49 ロイター

item.title: Florida asks court to bar OpenAI from developing new models as part of child harm lawsuit
item.description: Florida's attorney general asked a judge on Monday to bar OpenAI from developing new artificial intelligence models without outside oversight as part of its lawsuit accusing the company of harming children.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Florida's attorney general asked a judge on Monday to bar OpenAI from developing new artificial intelligence models without outside oversight as part of its lawsuit accusing the company of harming children. Florida [USN:L6N429106 TEXT:"sued OpenAI"] in June accusing the company of misrepresenting the safety of its ChatGPT platform, saying it has harmed children by providing information to school shooters, offering guidance on self-harm and addicting young users. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier in Monday's filing also asked the court to order OpenAI to keep minors off ChatGPT and bar the company from giving its chat platform “human attributes.” A spokesperson for OpenAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The filing cites recent comments from a former OpenAI employee and a current board member of the company, claiming that AI development could lead to the end of humankind and must be slowed down. “Defendants claim they cannot stop barreling forward with their potentially civilization-ending endeavors unless they are forced to do so by the government,” Florida wrote in Monday’s filing. “They have asked the government to tie them to the mast.” Uthmeier, a Republican, is the first state attorney general to sue OpenAI over its impact on young users. The company is also facing [USN:L6N45D0ZP TEXT:"lawsuits"] brought by individuals and families who say ChatGPT led people to harm themselves or others. Florida's lawsuit was prompted by [USN:L6N41O0YJ TEXT:"a shooting"] at a Tallahassee university last year and a number of events in other states where ChatGPT allegedly provided information to people who went on to commit violent acts. The company has denied it should be liable in those cases. It has said the chatbot provides information broadly available online, and that it continues to update its safety tools. OpenAI and other AI companies are also facing questions about what kind of liability they could face for rogue AI attacks by their models, amid reports that some have [USN:L6N45H0LE TEXT:"attempted to hack"] into the websites of governmental agencies and companies.

item.title: UK diesel prices hit record highs due to impact of Iran war
item.description: The price of diesel at the pump in the United Kingdom has hit record highs due to the US-Israeli war on Iran, the motoring body RAC said in a release on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The price of diesel at the pump in the United Kingdom has hit record highs due to the US-Israeli war on Iran, the motoring body RAC said in a release on Monday. As well as hitting motorists' pockets, high diesel costs are adding to logistical and transport costs for a vast array of goods, as the fuel is widely used in industry and agriculture. The cost of a litre of diesel is now 199.18 pence and the cost of filling up an average family car is now almost £110, £31 more than before the conflict began, Simon Williams, the RAC's head of policy, said in the release. The price high on Monday eclipsed the previous highest price of 199.09 pence in June 2022, during the acute energy market shock in the aftermath of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. "Only a sustained lower oil price — over several weeks, not days — will lead to cheaper prices at the pumps ... the government could take steps to ease the burden on drivers by lowering fuel duty further or reducing VAT," Williams said. Fuel prices are one of the key drivers of UK inflation, which [USN:L8N4570MM TEXT:"hit a five-month high"] in August, adding pressure on consumers who are grappling with a protracted cost-of-living crisis. UK diesel prices are still lower than in several European markets. RAC data for September 21 showed the UK was tied with Italy for the seventh-highest diesel prices among 15 European countries, with the Netherlands, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Belgium and France ranking above it. International diesel prices have surged to record highs in recent months due to shrinking global refining capacity and supply disruptions from conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine. Prices jumped again last week after US President Donald Trump voiced support for a [USN:L4N45K04P TEXT:"potential ban"] on US diesel exports, which would leave net importers like the UK and other European nations scrambling for alternatives. The UK has four working oil refineries with a combined crude processing capacity of 1 million barrels per day, down from 1.27 million bpd across six plants in 2024, as two sites closed last year. Diesel imports made up nearly 40% of the UK's total imports of oil products in 2025, with the U.S. accounting for 31%, according to the recent Digest of UK Energy Statistics. The UK imports nearly 55% of the diesel it consumes.

item.title: Fed watchdog flags apparent data breaches by retiring staff member
item.description: The Federal Reserve’s in-house watchdog said on Monday that a retiring staff member was caught multiple times trying to remove confidential central bank information as this employee exited the central bank, while noting this apparent breach did not ultimately trigger a formal misconduct finding.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve’s in-house watchdog said on Monday that a retiring staff member was caught multiple times trying to remove confidential central bank information as this employee exited the central bank, while noting this apparent breach did not ultimately trigger a formal misconduct finding. The Fed’s Inspector General said the departing employee served in the central bank’s Division of International Finance and retired from the central bank in July 2024. The Fed’s IG did not respond to a request to provide the identity of the employee flagged in the IG report. The Fed’s Board of Governors did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The IG said that despite the “potential severity” of the incident, its internal investigators “reviewed this matter for potential misconduct and determined that there was not a sufficient basis to pursue this incident as a misconduct investigation.” That’s because “available records did not provide a clear indication of what information the employee had removed before their departure” and “many” of the alerts involving the information “were, in fact, false positives,” the IG said. “The specific details regarding this incident help to illustrate the systemic concerns” about how the Fed manages the exit process of central bank employees with access to confidential policymaking information, the IG report said. Breakdowns in the process highlighted by the “potential incident” involving the retiring employee require “the Board's immediate attention so that it can take appropriate corrective actions.” INFORMATION EXFILTRATION The IG report recounted a series of incidents involving the employee as the staffer headed to retirement and flagged alerts involving information handling that occurred “three days before the employee took what we understood to be a personal trip to a restricted country, which was followed by a separate personal month-long international trip.” The IG said it became aware of the issues around the retiring employee in July 2025. The report says this employee was first flagged for copying confidential Federal Open Market Committee files to an unencrypted USB drive in 2021, and that the employee claimed this had been done mistakenly. In 2023, this employee attempted to email to a personal address more confidential FOMC files, which the employee claimed was “inadvertent.” In 2023 the employee was again flagged for copying classified files to an unencrypted USB drive. Before leaving, the IG said the retiring employee had generated a series of alerts “because of printing, copying data to a notepad application, sending potentially sensitive information in emails to multiple personal email addresses, and transferring potentially sensitive files to a Board-issued unencrypted USB device.” The employee removed the information without seeking approval and “despite previously being informed of the offboarding information removal procedures, prior counseling about bulk information transfers, and prior verbal counseling about using unencrypted storage devices,” the IG said. The Fed IG investigates internal issues faced by the central bank and has played a prominent role in recent years in probing trading activity by a range of Fed policymakers. The IG warned in a report in [USN:L6N42O17Q TEXT:"June"] that the Fed needed to take greater care in protecting confidential information during staff international travel. The IG is currently engaged in a high-profile [USN:L6N41G04N TEXT:"investigation"] into cost overruns incurred as part of the renovation of the central bank’s Washington headquarters. President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly attacked the Fed, had tried to use the renovations issue as an avenue to fire then-Fed Chair Jerome Powell, who now serves as a governor with Trump-installed Kevin Warsh as the current central bank leader.

FAST

Sept 28 : Roberto Mancini, who led Manchester City to their first top-flight title in over four decades in 2012, has brushed aside concerns over a "double contract" the Italian is alleged to have had in his four-year spell as the Premier League club's manager. German magazine Der Spiegel reported in 2018 that Mancini had earned a larger sum than his base salary at City for simultaneously serving as a consultant at the Abu Dhabi-based club Al Jazira, which is owned by a company chaired by City's majority owner Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The 61-year-old Mancini, who is now Italy manager, was asked about his alleged former dual role after last week's media reports said that City had been found guilty of 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules in a long-running case. "It's not a problem that concerns me, for one thing," Mancini told a press conference ahead of Monday's Nations League clash with Turkey in Bursa.

"It's nothing new, because I think it's been coming up every now and then for four or five years. Manchester City isn't guilty, and the dual contract issue absolutely doesn't concern me. It's their problem, if anything." Reuters has reached out to City for comment. City, who have won eight Premier League titles in the last 15 years, have denied any wrongdoing. Club chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak said on Saturday that City remained confident of proving their innocence.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Sept 28 : Fast-fashion platform Shein reported a sharp drop in sales in Europe in the second quarter after it hiked prices and cut online advertising in anticipation of the European Union imposing fees on low-value e-commerce parcels from July 1. Since its September 1 debut in Hong Kong, Shein's shares have dropped 27.3 per cent from the offer price of HK$48.56 apiece as investors expect the fees to dent its business in a market accounting for around a third of revenue. Shein reported $11.08 billion in sales for the second quarter, with Europe revenue down 13.9 per cent to $3.77 billion and US revenue falling 6 per cent to $2.5 billion. Overall sales were up 0.9 per cent from a year ago as growth in Latin America offset declines in Shein's biggest markets.  Shein CEO and Chair Sky Xu said the retailer is planning to push into higher-priced clothes that will boost its profitability, and hinted at the company's strategy of expanding its family of brands, including through acquisitions.

"As the product mix shifts towards brands at higher price points, the platform’s overall average selling price will rise accordingly," he said in a statement. "Our vision is to become a richly diversified brand collection that meets consumers’ varied needs across multiple price points and occasions." Shein's net profit margin shrank to 2.1 per cent in the second quarter from 6.2 per cent a year ago, mostly due to the Middle East conflict pushing up oil prices and freight costs, driving Shein's fulfilment expenses up by 18.1 per cent. CUSTOMS FEES IMPACT STILL TO COME Known for selling $5 dresses and $10 jeans and running permanent discounts, Shein was already forced to raise prices in the US last year when the Trump administration ended de minimis - duty-free access for low-value ecommerce parcels - and this year faces the same challenge in Europe. Since July 1 the EU has imposed fees on low-value parcels ordered online - 3 euros per customs code, adding up to 15 euros if a shopper buys five different types of item in one order. Shein's third-quarter results will show more of the impact, which Shein has previously said could exceed that of the US removing de minimis last year.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Slate Grocery REIT to be acquired in deal valued at US$2.3 billion
item.description: Slate Grocery REIT has signed a deal to be acquired by Brixmor Property Group Inc. and Everview Partners in an agreement that values the trust at US$2.3 billion.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: TORONTO — Slate Grocery REIT has signed a deal to be acquired by Brixmor Property Group Inc. and Everview Partners in an agreement that values the trust at US$2.3 billion. The purchase comes after Slate launched a review of strategic alternatives in May. The Toronto-listed trust, which owns a portfolio of U.S. grocery store-anchored real estate properties, says the buyers have agreed to pay US$13 per unit in cash to take it private. Marc Rouleau, chair of Slate’s special committee, says the deal provides unitholders with immediate liquidity and certainty of value at an attractive all-cash price. Brixmor owns and operates a portfolio of open-air shopping centres in the U.S., while Everview Partners is a private investment management firm. The deal, which requires unitholder approval, is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 28, 2026.

item.title: 中国、景気下支え強化へ 成長目標達成に向け国務院が方針
item.description: [北京 ２８日 ロイター] - 中国国務院（内閣に相当）は２８日、経済への圧力が強まる中、景気下支えに向けた政策支援を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、景気下支え強化へ　成長目標達成に向け国務院が方針 9/28 23:15 配信

2026年5月11日、中国・北京の街並み。ロイター／Tingshu Wang

[北京 ２８日 ロイター] - 中国国務院（内閣に相当）は２８日、経済への圧力が強まる中、景気下支えに向けた政策支援を強化する方針を示した。成長を軌道に乗せ、２６年の成長率目標達成に向けて景気下支えを急ぐ姿勢を示している。

国営メディアが伝えた国務院会議の概要によると、「足元の経済運営で生じた問題に対応するため、景気変動を抑えるマクロ経済政策の調整を強化し、経済の持続的な改善と高度化を促進し、２６年の経済・社会発展目標の達成に努めるべきだ」とし、既存の政策措置をより効果的に実施するとともに、政府債券の発行と調達資金の活用を加速する必要があるとした。

また、２６─３０年の５カ年計画に盛り込まれた全国的な６つのネットワークに関連する主要インフラ事業について、できるだけ早期に着工するよう求めた。

中国指導部は、財政支出の加速や新たな政策の「適時」導入を通じて、減速する経済を下支えすると表明している。政府は２６年の経済成長率目標を４．５─５％に設定している。

国務院は、利子補給やインフラの更新、対象を絞った政策措置などを通じ、投資と消費への支援を一段と強化する方針も示した。財政支出の効率化や地方政府の未使用の債務発行枠の一層の活用、金融政策手段の柔軟な運用も求めた。

さらに、技術革新、産業の高度化、農業、小規模企業向けの再貸し出し制度を拡充するとともに、住宅市場や雇用、所得の伸びを支援する新たな措置を検討するとした。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：中国政府、株市場てこ入れ作戦に公的年金基金も動員 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：経済モデル転換目指す中国、不動産不況でも資源需要衰えず コラム：「カメ」の米国株が「ウサギ」の中国を追い抜く時 最終更新: 9/28(月) 23:15 ロイター

item.title: スペースX「スターシップ」､初の軌道投入に成功－商用化へ重要な節目
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 宇宙技術開発大手、米スペースXの巨大ロケット「スターシップ」は現地時間28日朝、初めて軌道に到達した。上昇中にエンジン1基が故障し、一時はミッション遂行が危ぶまれたものの、同計画にとって節目となる成果を達成した。

スターシップは現地時間午前7時49分、テキサス州南部のスターベース発射施設から打ち上げられた。今回の試験飛行は約10時間に及ぶ可能性がある。ロケットには同社の改良型スターリンク衛星26基が搭載されており、スペースXはこれらを軌道上に展開し、既存の宇宙インターネット網を強化する計画だ。

スターシップは打ち上げから約35分後に衛星の展開を開始した。飛行開始から約1時間後、衛星26基すべての軌道展開に成功したと明らかにした。

スターシップが宇宙に向けて上昇する途中、6基あるラプターエンジンのうち1基が予定より早く停止したため、スペースXのエンジニアチームは軌道投入の試みを一時中止した。しかし、データを確認した後、チームは試みを再開し、スターシップのラプターエンジン1基を燃焼させ、機体を初めて軌道に投入した。

今回のスターシップ試験飛行は14回目で、スペースXにとって重要な節目となる。これまでの打ち上げはいずれも、安全性を最大限確保するため、意図的に軌道到達の手前にとどめていた。米規制当局は今回、スペースXがスターシップを次の段階へ進めることを承認し、同社が機体を安全に軌道速度まで加速させ、制御された形で地球へ帰還させられると判断した。

原題：SpaceX’s Starship Reaches Orbit for First Time in Major Test (2)（抜粋）

*SPACEX: ALL 26 SATELLITES ON STARSHIP ROCKET DEPLOYED IN ORBIT

item.title: ECB's Lagarde sticking to measured steps to quell inflation
item.description: This year's inflation surge has yet to generate dangerous second-round effects across the euro zone, so a moderate policy response from the European Central Bank remains appropriate, ECB chief Christine Lagarde said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: This year's inflation surge has yet to generate dangerous second-round effects across the euro zone, so a moderate policy response from the European Central Bank remains appropriate, ECB chief Christine Lagarde said on Monday. Euro zone inflation has already shot past 3% and may approach 4% by the end of the year, double the bank's target, fuelling market bets that up to four more rate hikes will be needed in the next year on top of two moves over the summer. Lagarde, however, appeared to push back on some of the most aggressive market bets, arguing that surging oil and gas prices, stemming from the US-Iran conflict , are the main driver of higher prices. "We see higher inflation ahead but no signs yet that it is becoming embedded," she told a European Parliament committee hearing in Brussels. "We do not see evidence at this stage of energy prices feeding into higher wages." "This means that while the shock is too large to look through, we view a measured response as appropriate to keep inflation in check," she added. Lagarde acknowledged that risks were skewed towards higher inflation and there was also a risk in governments offering generous subsidies to help shield consumers against higher energy costs. Fiscal support has now increased to around 0.1 percentage points of euro zone GDP and the measures were far less temporary or targeted than hoped, Lagarde said. The collective effect of these measures will have a roughly 0.1% impact on inflation, she added. The issue is that while subsidies help lower inflation in the short term, they often prolong inflation over a longer period and push up fiscal expenditure, causing more lasting issues. While Lagarde did not detail what she meant by a "measured response," economists say that the first two rate hikes, coming three months apart, are a good guide. This is why many economists see the ECB sitting out its October 29 meeting and hiking only in December, when new projections are released. These views were reinforced on Monday when Lagarde repeated her earlier message that interest rates will not move in lockstep with energy costs. On the economy, Lagarde remained upbeat, arguing that manufacturing is performing solidly, the labour market remains robust and investment should also support growth.

item.title: ベッセント米財務長官、ジェフリーズのゼルボス氏を顧問に起用
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米財務省は28日、投資銀行ジェフリーズで市場や政策を長く分析してきたデビッド・ゼルボス氏を、ベッセント米財務長官の顧問に起用したと発表した。具体的な役割は明らかにしていない。

財務省は、発表文で「ゼルボス氏は世界の金融市場、中央銀行、マクロ経済分析の分野で35年の経験を持つ」と説明した。同氏は別の文書で、任期は4月までとしている。

ゼルボス氏は以前、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）でエコノミストとして勤務し、その後ジェフリーズでチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジストを務め、FRBについて幅広く論評してきた。昨年は、パウエルFRB議長（当時）の後任候補者の1人とも報じられた。

ベッセント氏が昨年初めに長官に就任して以降、米財務省では幹部の入れ替わりが比較的増えている。超党派の政府監視団体パートナーシップ・フォー・パブリック・サービスによると、ベッセント氏に次ぐ上位職である副長官と次官2人を含め、これまでに上院の承認を受けて就任した幹部7人が退任した。

ベッセント氏が顧問に迎えるゼルボス氏は昨年、FRBによる利下げを支持し、パウエル氏を「反トランプ」の工作員だと批判していた。

ゼルボス氏は、顧客向けの文書で「米国のリスク資産市場に対する私の長年の楽観的な見方は、政権の主張にも間違いなく容易になじむだろう」と述べた。

ジェフリーズの広報からは、今のところコメントを得られていない。ゼルボス氏の財務省顧問への起用については、CNBCが先に報じていた。

原題：Bessent Taps Market Strategist Zervos as Treasury Adviser (1)　（抜粋）

item.title: エヌビディア、自社株買い計画を1500億ドル増額－持続的な成長を確信
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米エヌビディアは自社株買い計画の規模を1500億ドル（約23兆5700億円）引き上げた。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（CEO）による同社の持続的な成長に対する自信が反映された。これにより、承認済みの自社株買いの残額は2350億ドルとなる。

28日の発表によれば、同社は2028年度までに自社株買いを完了する見通しだ。

AIモデルやインフラの開発競争を背景に、エヌビディアの画像処理半導体（GPU）への需要が拡大し、同社は時価総額で世界最大の企業となった。ただ最近では、予想利益に対するエヌビディア株の割高感は薄れている。AI関連の巨額投資が持続可能かどうかを巡る市場の懸念を反映している。

フアン氏は発表資料で、「エヌビディアの成長をけん引しているのは、AIとアクセラレーテッド・コンピューティングへのプラットフォームの転換で、数十年ぶりの大きな変化だ」と指摘。「今回の承認は、今後の長期的な事業機会に対するわれわれの自信を反映している」と述べた。

同氏はまた、技術開発のペースを落とすべきだとの主張に反論しており、アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイCEOやOpenAIのサム・アルトマン氏ら一部のAI企業トップとは異なる立場を取っている。AIエージェントが引き起こした注目度の高いセキュリティー侵害を受け、業界ではAI開発をより慎重なペースで進めることについて議論が始まった。

エヌビディアはまた、自社ハードウエア上で稼働する新たなAIセキュリティーシステムも発表した。同社によると、このシステムがあれば、OpenAIが誤ってハギングフェイスに侵入した問題を防げたという。エヌビディアが投入するのは、オープンソースのセキュリティーソフトウエア２本で、AIエージェントがアクセスできる対象をリアルタイムで制御する仕組みだ。

原題：Nvidia’s Huang Boosts Share Buyback by a Record $150 Billion (1)

item.title: Inflação na zona do euro ainda exige apenas uma resposta moderada do BCE, diz Lagarde
item.description: O aumento da inflação neste ano ainda não gerou efeitos secundários perigosos em toda a zona do euro, portanto uma resposta moderada do Banco Central Europeu (BCE) continua sendo a reação apropriada, afirmou a presidente do BCE, Christine Lagarde, nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O aumento da inflação neste ano ainda não gerou efeitos secundários perigosos em toda a zona do euro, portanto uma resposta moderada do Banco Central Europeu (BCE) continua sendo a reação apropriada, afirmou a presidente do BCE, Christine Lagarde, nesta segunda-feira. A inflação na zona do euro já ultrapassou os 3% e pode se aproximar dos 4% até o final do ano — o dobro da meta do banco —, alimentando apostas do mercado de que serão necessários até mais quatro aumentos nas taxas de juros no próximo ano, além das duas altas durante o verão no hemisfério norte. Lagarde, no entanto, pareceu refutar algumas das apostas mais agressivas do mercado, argumentando que a alta nos preços do petróleo e do gás, decorrente do conflito entre os EUA e o Irã, é o principal fator por trás do aumento dos preços. “Prevemos uma inflação mais alta à frente, mas ainda não há sinais de que ela esteja se tornando estrutural”, disse ela em uma audiência perante uma comissão do Parlamento Europeu em Bruxelas. “Não vemos, nesta fase, evidências de que os preços da energia estejam levando a salários mais altos.” “Isso significa que, embora o choque seja grande demais para ser ignorado, consideramos uma resposta moderada adequada para manter a inflação sob controle”, acrescentou ela. Lagarde reconheceu que os riscos apontam para uma inflação mais elevada e que também há o risco de os governos oferecerem subsídios generosos para ajudar a proteger os consumidores contra os custos mais altos da energia. O apoio fiscal aumentou agora para cerca de 0,1 ponto percentual do PIB da zona do euro, e as medidas foram muito menos temporárias ou direcionadas do que se esperava, disse Lagarde. O efeito coletivo dessas medidas terá um impacto de aproximadamente 0,1% sobre a inflação, acrescentou ela. A questão é que, embora os subsídios ajudem a reduzir a inflação no curto prazo, eles muitas vezes prolongam a inflação por um período mais longo e elevam os gastos fiscais, causando problemas mais duradouros. Embora Lagarde não tenha detalhado o que entende por uma “resposta moderada”, economistas afirmam que os dois primeiros aumentos da taxa de juros, com intervalo de três meses entre si, são um bom indicador. É por isso que muitos economistas acreditam que o BCE não tomará medidas em sua reunião de 29 de outubro e só aumentará as taxas em dezembro, quando novas projeções forem divulgadas. Essas opiniões foram reforçadas nesta segunda-feira, quando Lagarde repetiu sua mensagem anterior de que as taxas de juros não acompanharão de forma sincronizada os custos da energia. Quanto à economia, Lagarde manteve-se otimista, argumentando que o setor manufatureiro apresenta um desempenho sólido, o mercado de trabalho continua robusto e os investimentos também devem apoiar o crescimento. (Reportagem de Balazs Koranyi)

item.title: エヌビディア、自社株買い枠1500億ドル拡大 過去最大の増額
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手のエヌビディアは、自社株買い枠を１５００億ドル拡大した。同社として過去最大規模の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア、自社株買い枠1500億ドル拡大　過去最大の増額 9/28 22:56 配信

米半導体大手エヌビディアのロゴ。６月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２８日　ロイター] - 米半導体大手のエヌビディアは、自社株買い枠を１５００億ドル拡大した。同社として過去最大規模の増額で、２０２４年にアップルが承認した１１００億ドルをも上回る。

今回の追加承認により、エヌビディアの自社株買いの総額は２３５０億ドルに拡大した。人工知能（ＡＩ）の学習・推論向け需要の急拡大を背景に生み出される潤沢なキャッシュを活用し、２０２８会計年度までに使い切る見込みという。

エヌビディア株は一時２％超上昇した。同社株は前営業日終値時点で年初来２０％超上昇していた。

ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「当社のキャッシュ創出力は、この変革を推進する技術への投資と株主還元を両立する余力をもたらしている」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、今回の１５００億ドルの増額規模は、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数を構成する企業約８４％の時価総額を上回る。

Ｅｍａｒｋｅｔｅｒのアナリスト、ジェイコブ・ボーン氏は「ＡＩ投資拡大が現在のペースで永続するわけではないが、エヌビディアが自社のハードウエアやサービスに対する需要の持続性に自信を持っていることを示している」と指摘した。

ＬＳＥＧがまとめたデータによると、同社の今後１２カ月の予想利益に基づく株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）は約１６．５倍と１５年１月以来の低水準で、過去１５年の平均である３０倍を大幅に下回っている。一部のアナリストは、これを利益成長への期待が鈍化している兆候だと指摘している。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：逆風強まる米国株、タカ派的ＦＲＢと利回り上昇に政府機関閉鎖の恐れも アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで アングル：ハイテク株への依存度を高める米株価指数、新たなリスクも 焦点：最高値圏に戻した米株、投機ポジションやオプション取引は一段高示唆 焦点：米株がイラン攻撃前の水準回復、短期終結への期待変わらず 最終更新: 9/29(火) 1:32 ロイター

item.title: Kyiv Science Academy hit as Russian jet-drones strike across Ukraine
item.description: At least one person was killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the centre of the Ukrainian capital.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least one person was killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the centre of the Ukrainian capital. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a total of 19 people had been injured, six of whom were being treated in hospital. Sirens echoed through the streets as black smoke billowed into the sky. In recent weeks, Russia has begun hitting Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with faster, high-flying jet drones. President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Saturday that Ukraine was able to intercept only just over half - far fewer than when facing the older, propeller-powered versions. A pharmaceutical company, petrol stations and a medical facility were also hit in Kyiv on Monday, Zelenskiy said, while in other cities and regions, civilian facilities, businesses and communications infrastructure were targeted. "Every one of Ukraine's partners must see from this terror, from these strikes, that supporting Ukraine means truly supporting people's lives," Zelenskiy said on the Telegram app. ATTACK ON BUSINESS CENTRE IN DNIPRO In the southeastern city of Dnipro, a Russian drone attack on a business centre killed three, officials said. In particular, Russia has been widening its attacks on economic targets beyond warehouses, port facilities and energy infrastructure, in recent days hitting data centres and telecoms facilities. Another person was killed in a logistics office in Synelnykove, southeast of Dnipro, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said. In Kyiv, flames leaped from the historic Academy building, where rubble was strewn across the courtyard. Firefighters doused the building in water and searched for people in the wreckage. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha accused Russia of cynicism for targeting a scientific institution in the middle of the working day. "Russia is deliberately expanding the boundaries of what it believes the world will tolerate. Every attack left without a strong response only encourages the next one," he said. Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said 19 people had been injured in the daytime attack on the business centre in Dnipro. Hanzha said the centre was surrounded by residential buildings, a park, a library and offices in the heart of the city: "Hundreds of people are here in the middle of the working day." Ukraine has also increased attacks on Russia, targeting oil refineries as well as online retailers to try to undermine revenues and support for Moscow's war effort. Zelenskiy said on Monday that it had struck Russian oil facilities in the Krasnodar region and two defence plants. Both sides have denied deliberately targeting civilians.

item.title: Thyssenkrupp Steel soll profitabler werden
item.description: Die Stahlsparte von Thyssenkrupp will ihr Ergebnis in den kommenden Jahren deutlich verbessern. Mittelfristig peile das Unternehmen ein bereinigtes Ebitda von mindestens 1,2 Milliarden Euro an, sagte die Chefin von Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe, Marie Jaroni, am Montag auf dem Capital Markets Day des größten deutschen Stahlkonzerns. Im Geschäftsjahr 2024/25 hatte die Stahlsparte ein bereinigtes Ebitda von 384 Millionen Euro erzielt. Die bereinigte Ebitda-Marge soll mittelfristig mindestens elf Prozent betragen, der Free Cashflow soll positiv sein. Aus sogenannten "Self-Help-Maßnahmen" sollen mehr als 800 Millionen Euro zusammenkommen. Ein konkretes Jahr, in dem die Mittelfristziele erreicht werden sollen, nannte das Unternehmen nicht.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Stahlsparte von Thyssenkrupp (TKAG.DE) will ihr Ergebnis in den kommenden Jahren deutlich verbessern. Mittelfristig peile das Unternehmen ein bereinigtes Ebitda von mindestens 1,2 Milliarden Euro an, sagte die Chefin von Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe, Marie Jaroni, am Montag auf dem Capital Markets Day des größten deutschen Stahlkonzerns. Im Geschäftsjahr 2024/25 hatte die Stahlsparte ein bereinigtes Ebitda von 384 Millionen Euro erzielt. Die bereinigte Ebitda-Marge soll mittelfristig mindestens elf Prozent betragen, der Free Cashflow soll positiv sein. Aus sogenannten "Self-Help-Maßnahmen" sollen mehr als 800 Millionen Euro zusammenkommen. Ein konkretes Jahr, in dem die Mittelfristziele erreicht werden sollen, nannte das Unternehmen nicht. Der Chef des Mutterkonzerns Thyssenkrupp, Miguel Lopez, will für das konjunkturanfällige Stahlgeschäft Investoren gewinnen. "Die Verselbstständigung von Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe mit einer eventuellen Minderheitsbeteiligung der Thyssenkrupp AG bleibt das erklärte strategische Ziel", bekräftigte der Konzern. Der Stahlkocher treibt Kostensenkungen und den Abbau von bis zu 11.000 der einst rund 26.000 Stellen voran. Jaroni zufolge ist das Programm bereits bei rund 4000 Stellen umgesetzt worden. Positiv werde sich auch die Trennung von den Hüttenwerken Krupp Mannesmann (HKM) auswirken. Thyssenkrupp hatte seinen Anteil an den Salzgitter (SZGG.DE) -Konzern weitergereicht. EU-SCHUTZMASSNAHMEN SORGEN FÜR RÜCKENWIND Die europäische Stahlindustrie mit Playern wie Thyssenkrupp Steel, Salzgitter oder ArcelorMittal (MT.LU) kämpft seit Jahren mit Überkapazitäten, hohen Energiekosten und der Billig-Konkurrenz aus Fernost. Positive Impulse erwartet die Schwerindustrie von neuen Handelsschutzmaßnahmen der EU. Diese sorgten für Schwung, sagte Jaroni, die seit November 2025 das Stahlgeschäft führt. Mehr als 80 Prozent des europäischen Flachstahlmarktes würden inzwischen von den neuen Quoten- und Zollregelungen erfasst, was zu einer höheren Marktstabilität und einem unterstützenden Preisumfeld beitrage. Wichtigster Kunde für Thyssenkrupp Steel ist weiterhin die Automobilindustrie. Einbußen der Nachfrage bei europäischen Herstellern würden durch chinesische Autokonzerne mehr als wettgemacht, sagte Jaroni. Diese bauten Fabriken und etablierten Lieferketten, erklärte die Managerin mit Verweis auf Hersteller wie BYD (002594.SZ) oder Geely (0175.HK) .

item.title: US stocks: US market drops as Trump’s rejection of Iran peace plan lifts oil prices
item.description: Following President Trump's dismissal of Iran's peace proposal, US market indexes experienced a downward trend, spurred by a notable surge in crude prices. This escalation raised inflation worries, consequently leading to an uptick in Treasury yields and impacting economic outlooks. Meanwhile, Nvidia's stock showed resilience, buoyed by an announcement of substantial share repurchases, albeit only slightly supporting broader market sentiments.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: US market’s main indexes fell on Monday after President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to end the conflict, sending crude prices higher, reviving inflation concerns and pushing Treasury yields up, Reuters reported.Nvidia offered some support to the broader market, rising 3.2% after the chipmaker authorised a $150 billion share repurchase—the largest buyback approval in its history.Iran unveiled a peace proposal at last week’s United Nations General Assembly in New York and said it had been conveyed to the United States through Qatari mediators. Trump said on Saturday that he had rejected the offer, though he told Axios on Sunday that he expected US negotiators to continue talks this week.Crude prices climbed 2% to around $107 a barrel. The increase also weighed on Treasuries, driving longer-dated yields to fresh multidecade highs.“Energy has been the one consistent upward pressure on inflation, and anything that continues to put pressure on inflation is going to be something that motivates the Fed to raise rates,” Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth, told Reuters.Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 245.02 points, or 0.47%, at 51,583.60. The S&P 500 lost 36.08 points, or 0.46%, to 7,707.50, while the Nasdaq Composite fell 175.16 points, or 0.65%, to 26,893.56.Consumer discretionary stocks led declines among S&P 500 sectors, falling 1.3%. DoorDash and Carvana dropped 6% and 5%, respectively.According to Reuters, Investors found some relief on the trade front after the US-China summit concluded last week with the two countries agreeing to reduce tariffs on $60 billion worth of goods imported from each other. They also extended their trade truce by two months, through January 10.Attention later this week will turn to a series of key economic indicators. Traders are pricing in a 68% chance that the Federal Reserve will follow its September increase with another rate hike of at least 25 basis points in October, according to CME Group’s FedWatch Tool.“Any historical instance of the Fed hiking into a short-term supply shock has always ended poorly. And the Fed is being impatient. They shouldn’t have hiked in September. They could potentially make the same mistake in October,” said Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital.The August Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index and September nonfarm payrolls report, both due this week, could offer further clues about the Fed’s policy path.Fed policymakers Michelle Bowman, Lisa Cook and Thomas Barkin are scheduled to speak later on Monday and could reinforce the central bank’s hawkish shift since its previous meeting.Tesla fell 2.7% after JP Morgan lowered its price target on the stock, citing weak third-quarter deliveries. Meta declined nearly 4% after surging 13% last week.Declining stocks outnumbered advancers by 2.81 to 1 on the NYSE and by 3.03 to 1 on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 recorded no new 52-week highs and 19 new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite posted 14 new highs and 127 new lows.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)
